programme.desc: 藍組最後一位成員上場踢館，入廚十多年，喜歡創新，但不擅長中菜，今集要挑戰正是一間具有藝術氣息裝潢的潮州菜館，要挑戰的大廚是入行三十年的餐館總廚吳啟成師傅。挑戰者入廚資歷較淺，唯有將菜式加入創意取勝，將原本的招牌菜改頭換面，效果會是弄巧成拙，還是別具心思.(n)

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 超人奧米加
妳想生活
programme.desc: 安居樂業向來是許多人的目標，偏偏今集的嘉賓 Hayley 卻是「居無定所」：每個月甚至每星期就會換一次居住地方。到底這種 Luggage Lifestyle 又是如何吸引 Hayley 一直堅持.(n)

programme.title: NBA 常規賽 -奧克拉荷馬雷霆 對 明尼蘇達木狼
programme.desc: 奧克拉荷馬雷霆 對 明尼蘇達木狼.(n)

programme.title: 單車踩爆日本 -女神下水禮-周參見、白濱
programme.desc: 蘇皓兒下水禮?! 踩單車來到周參見呢個沿海小鎮，蘇皓兒及陳安立呢對運動型閨密，不但止單車瓹山窿踩上山搵絕景，仲要落埋海挑戰划獨木舟，鬥快穿越水中鳥居！輸贏唔重要，最緊要女神收伏埋單車少年，登堂入室去見埋家長.(n)

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.sub-title: 嘉賓: 洪嘉豪、Nancy Kwai 歸綽嶢
programme.desc: 本集邀請到 洪嘉豪 與 Nancy Kwai 歸綽嶢 為嘉賓，帶來交換靈魂的奇遇記，兩位將會互唱對方作品，演繹出不同感覺，更會演唱各自的新歌，讓樂迷先聽為快。本集亦有《全民造星VI》參賽者 陳俊傑 翻唱《笑忘書》，而且有「CHILL CLUB推介榜」，與樂迷公布本周第一至十位推介歌曲.(n)

programme.title: 手尋藝術
programme.desc: 原型師Ray Wong年輕時受雕塑家朱達誠先生啟發，開始探索雕塑的無限可能，最後更全情投入創作之路。今集，他除了分享由零開始的心路歷程，還會現場教主持雕塑人像的技巧.(n)

programme.title: 日本GAO芯假期
programme.desc: 經過幾日的排練和二人到處走訪許多大阪的名景點和打卡位，芯駖和Gao在大阪的生活多姿多彩，決定出走大阪，遠離塵囂，到寧靜的京都體驗生活。在京都的農村過上一夜，有如走進宮崎駿的動畫世界.(n)

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.desc: 節目組為了讓幾對婆媳多些相處增進感情，特意安排她們去四個不同地方「拍拖約會」，莊韻澄 (Xenia) 和奶奶鄧心明 (阿碧) 會去流水蝦餐廳，實行邊玩邊食；江若琳 (Elanne) 和奶奶黎碧芬 (Peggy) 到山頂餐廳用膳，Peggy更大爆與老爺的拍拖史。郭玥彤 (Celia) 和梁綺芬 (Connie) 到中環餐廳午膳，Celia大爆不滿老公帶她去的拍拖地方。另外，四對婆媳亦會體驗雙人瑜珈活動，節目組更請到Coffee到場教授大家，不過熱身環節主持阿正已相當吃力，似乎柔軟度比在場奶奶還要差，令全場工作人員難以忍笑.(n)

programme.title: 全運港將 第17集 -男子水球 - 程梓舜、鄭希文
programme.desc: 水球於香港算是較為冷門的運動，但原來一樣有一隊熱愛水球的運動員代表香港出戰全運，為他們加油.(n)

programme.title: 熊熊幫幫團 2
programme.desc: 《熊熊幫幫團 2》講述了大寶二寶和利華組成的「熊熊幫幫團」幫助小朋友解決困難和煩惱的故事。 著重展現孩子們樂於助人、勇敢團結、智慧耐心、富有正義責任等美好成長品格，延續了溫暖、正義、輕鬆、愉快的故事風格。自從上部「熊熊幫幫團」組成後，已經為小鎮居民做了許多好事。 每當響起求助的警報，俏皮的團子、勇敢的大寶、可愛的二寶、機智的利華便會開啟絢麗的魔法通道，第一時間出現在需要幫助的人面前，他們活躍在小鎮和 森林四處，利用奇妙的魔法、聰明的頭腦、趣味的科技發明幫助大家，成為了森林小鎮的守護者，也成為了大家信賴的援手和正面榜樣。 但是，「熊熊幫幫團」即將面臨更多更大的挑戰！ 在幫忙、救援的過程中，他們將會碰到更多性格迥異、有著不同習慣的小朋友，還將遇到各種前所未有的困難和煩惱，「熊熊幫幫團」又會如何幫助大家解決 問題呢.(n)

programme.title: 光之美少女偶像與你
programme.sub-title: 突如其來的遊樂場約會！

programme.title: 世界之「趣」
programme.desc: 正所謂「世界之大無奇不有」！在這千奇百趣的世界裡，當中集合了許多有趣歷史和文化，不知你又認識幾多呢？就讓「AI導遊」考考你，與大家一起探索世界，成為「世界百科小博士」.(n)

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.(n)

programme.title: 幾廿歲人搞邊科？
programme.desc: 年紀大，身體自然多病痛，看似是步入老年的一代人都有的感受，亦是社會上固有的觀念，誰又想到銀齡之時，還能靈活走動、跑跳？長者「年輕時，為生計；退休後，為理想。」Carmen以身傳言，即使到了銀齡之期，只要心態保持平靜，一但有了目標，便要用認真的態度實行，做自己想做的事。75歲的她除了能隨時表演「一字馬」外更擁有芭蕾舞八級資格.(n)

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina呈獻: 磚造美學
programme.desc: 《磚造美學》旨在為觀眾提供有關家居設計和裝修的實用建議和靈感。該節目的主要目標是幫助人們打造舒適、實用和美觀的居住環境。節目會展示設計師的創意和專業技巧，包括如何最大限度地利用空間、選擇合適家具和裝飾品、使用合適的色彩和材料，以及如何創造一個舒適、時尚且個性化的居住環境。另外，節目會聚焦於一個家庭或個人的居住環境，透過參觀素人的家，了解他們對自己的家所花的心思，拼湊出一幅幅家居美畫。節目也會介紹簡單實用的裝潢技巧和D.I.Y項目，使觀眾在能夠有限的預算和時間下，對自己的家進行翻新.(n)

programme.title: 道地星期六影院: 阿索的故事
婚前試行為
programme.desc: 參加者與甘草演員 Bonnie 大玩婆媳劇場，作為熱身。Bernice 被奶奶大罵冇禮貌、卓瑩與奶奶打牌添感情、泰源慘被外母連環炮轟：「睇唔到你可以令阿女幸福！.(n)

programme.title: 嫌疑事件簿
programme.desc: My 叔之死仍未揭開真相，話劇社卻再添亡魂！ Phoebus、 Marco分別疑似中毒、中刀身亡，到底是何人所為？表面上關係簡單的話劇社眾人，卻有著不同的感情瓜葛。兇手是否仍然潛伏在眾人之間？大家又可否成功找出兇手.(n)

programme.title: 一路向西伯利亞
programme.desc: 兩位MC到伊爾庫茨克最有名的Café與兩位少艾見面，分別是擁有一雙清澈藍眼睛又喜歡攝影的Vika，和她由幼稚園已認識的Kamila，非常活潑好動，除了品嚐美食外，還在Café玩photo hunt，過程非常搞笑。到一戶外活動場地玩雪橇狗拉車，Louis更無懼嚴寒，一嚐俄羅斯傳統桑拿滋味，跳到冷冰冰的安加拉河裏，再浸熱水，冰火交融！勇氣可加！以為可以得到兩位美女的芳心，怎知在她們眼中，是正常不過的事….(n)

programme.title: 長知昔2 -灣仔玩具街
programme.desc: 昔日香港，長者知得最清楚！最佳嘅掌故王，當然係喺社區土生土長嘅老友記。睇住社區變化嘅資深居民帶領，向廿幾歲嘅年輕人，大談後生仔女意想不到嘅地區老故事。鰂魚涌山邊原來曾經有吊車上栢架山？灣仔大佛口以前係日本人社區？睇落保留傳統風味嘅大澳又有幾多嘢真係無變？唔同嘅老友記，有老街坊、有導賞團義工、有歷史發燒友，帶年輕主持行街 (或坐低慢慢傾)，同觀眾一齊話當年.(n)

programme.title: SE7EN
programme.sub-title: Se7en挑戰拉動數十噸民航機
programme.desc: Se7en，雖然代表一群不切實際的「廢青」，常常浪費時間去實現怪誕奇想，但是他們都有一顆為社會出力的心。今次要挑戰的，就是為慈善去發揮Se7en微小力量，去推動最重的物件！勢憑七人之力，拉動飛機滑行二十米！究竟Se7en想出甚麼奇招去完成挑戰.(n)

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 印度舞元素眾多，展現了多元的文化。今集主持繼續訪問印度舞平台的創辦人及舞者，了解更多印度舞的風情文化.(n)

programme.title: 少年談未來
programme.desc: 《少年談未来》是一個屬於青少年尋找職志方向的資訊性清談節目。每一集將會邀請到一位正在努力進修專業課程，或有職業目標的青少年與一位業內專業人士論盡職業當中的一切問題。專業人士除了慷慨解囊，更會帶出工作內容的特點，讓大家了解到真正職場的專業需求和適合的性格。透過本節目，青少年能夠了解到香港各個熱門職業的實戰一面，擺脫對職業的迷思和顧慮，在找到屬於自己的職業之前可以走更少冤枉路.(n)

programme.title: 環保發現號
programme.desc: 很多人都喜歡購買衣服，但衣服過時或不再實用，它們何去何從？今集主持訪問服裝店負責人，看看他們如何回收，為舊衣賦予新生命.(n)

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 獨居長者的身後事，往往是難以啟齒的話題，但提早準備卻能讓人生更有尊嚴。本集邀請長者義工服務團體主席及創會主席，分享他們如何為獨居長者安排身後事，實現無憾人生，並帶出社區互助的重要性.(n)

programme.title: 異國風情畫
programme.desc: 輪到Hailey和Sarika這對閨蜜接棒，展開一連三集的偽歐美遊，用念力帶大家跨越半個地球，將不同國家的特色美食和景色帶到大家眼前.(n)

programme.title: GO！執！事務所
programme.desc: 上集講到隊長 Jeremy 為事主重新規劃客廳區域，成功打造人貓共融的理想環境。在整理混亂廚房之際，GO! 執! 事務所不但發現史前三級影帶、恐怖發霉食 物，清理期間更出現令所有女成員聞風喪膽的小強光臨，四人將如何度過難關.(n)

programme.title: 夕陽新丁
programme.desc: 曾幾何時人們會為照相隆重其事，買新衫，化妝恤髮才讓攝影師操刀，那時還用菲林拍攝，按每下快門都是成本，必須快狠準。生於數碼世代的 YouTuber 波仔，相約家人到舊式影樓拍照，更拜師學做助手，重拾老技術的美.(n)

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 花式足球在香港雖然是小眾運動，但彭健發仍然默默地貢獻，推廣花式足球在香港的發展。自2010年代起活躍於香港街頭及國際賽事，常與香港其他花式足球員合作參賽或表演.(n)

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: No.1戰隊五獸者
programme.sub-title: 高貴怪力！新的暴龍是王子殿下

programme.title: 學界Create, Like and Share 第三季
programme.sub-title: 東華三院李東海小學 / 將軍澳香島中學
programme.desc: 全新充滿創意與活力的節目《學界Create, Like and Share》， 帶領觀眾深入探索香港各大學校的獨特魅力和多彩生活! 節目不僅聚焦學校的學術成就，更展現學生們的創意才華與日常趣事，讓觀眾感受到校園的創意與活力。每集節目中，校園導遊瑪姬邀請不同學校的學生團隊，展示他們的創意項目、藝術表演及社會服務，令觀眾更加了解學校！你可以透過這個節目一探學校的多樣性，發掘你未曾想過學校的有趣一面.(n)

programme.title: 辣王傳
programme.desc: 中菜博大精深，辣的菜色多到數不完。Isabella、中醫師甄茵與 Dee 就先去食辣的素菜，嗜辣如命的人食素菜也有不少選擇。然後三人再去食烤魚及冒菜，食四川人老闆的祖傳辣菜色。香辣、酸辣、椒麻、糊辣等不同的辣味，食到三個人停唔到口.(n)

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 幪面超人 ZEZTZ
深宵更 -印刷
programme.desc: 廣告噴畫公司原來都是深宵工作！Thor 今集在噴畫公司擔任生產助理一職，由噴畫操作、切割 Farmboard 、到製作易拉架等工序，Thor 漸漸領會生產助理一職在深宵工作的原因和香港人爭分奪秒的特質有關.(n)

programme.title: STEM By You
programme.desc: 近來極端天氣頻繁，有關溫室效應和全球暖化的討論也愈來愈多。兩者究竟有甚麼關係？會對我們的生活帶來甚麼影響？若地球沒有了溫室效應，又會變成怎樣.(n)

programme.title: 搵食考快Cert.

programme.title: 35+ LOVE
programme.sub-title: 阿Yu & Aka 各自開展九小時約會
programme.desc: 趙頌茹（Yu）與符致逸（Adrian）的九小時約會繼續，二人以一身復古打扮跳搖擺舞，及後他們欣賞樂隊表演，Adrian更即興演奏，到底有否令Yu留下印象？接近約會完結，二人細說相處感受，Yu如何看待二人關係？趙慧珊（Aka）與男參加者前往澳門展開約會，二人互動甜密，更穿搭情侶裝遊覧。及後Aka帶男參加者到一個對她別具意義的地方......趙頌茹（Yu）與徐澤銘（Marcus）相約露營，而Marcus再次遲到，令Yu不愉快？少有談及個人生活的二人，在今次約會當中會否打破沉默，令關係走近.(n)

programme.title: 恐怖醫學
programme.desc: 用情境劇來表現一些病症的發生，一些大家很少留意的症狀，但可能是某種嚴重疾病的先兆。再請該疾病領域的醫師，進行解說及分析，說明情境劇內發生的事情，可能已經在實際生活中發生了，並教觀眾如何做簡單的自我檢測，內容沒有艱深的醫學報導，戲劇表現生活化.(n)

programme.title: 漁樂無窮
programme.desc: 主持們正式喺日本釣魚，將之前練習嘅岸釣知識學以致用，專家亦會帶大家睇風向揀釣點，同埋佢哋會去泡瀨漁港參觀漁民嘅直營市場，融入當地嘅主持仲會著上傳統琉球服裝去學三線琴.(n)

programme.title: 穿越阿拉伯
programme.desc: 遊覽基督徒聖地尼波山-摩西葬身之地後，再參觀一個完美還原傳統阿拉伯生活的博物館，仲有機會試食阿拉伯自助餐。最後當然要去約旦死海朝聖啦，睇下Brian同Nina喺死海浮沉.(n)

programme.title: DrGo One Wellness呈獻: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 消化道佔人體很大的部分，如果出血，是哪部分出現問題？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來何雁詩一起請教醫生！究竟消化道為什麼會出血，又能如何醫治.(n)

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 不同年代也會誕生著不同的流行曲。開心時，你會聽著某些流行曲；悲傷時，你會聽著某些流行曲，這些流行曲總伴隨著你我長成。《Chill Club》透過主持駱振偉，聯同每集不同嘉賓，唱出不同年代的流行曲，重塑各個觀眾對那些流行曲的情懷及回憶。而且，每一集都會有「新歌推介」，令觀眾也可得知現時最新的流行曲.(n)

programme.title: 蠟筆小新
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事.(n)

programme.title: 大叔的愛－Returns－
programme.desc: 講述春田、黒澤、牧三人在《大叔的愛》五年後，跨越了疫情的生活。而社會上對性別多元亦有更大的接受程度，男同性戀情更被大眾認同下，這三人能否過著更幸福的生活呢.

programme.title: 私人銀行家
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突.

programme.title: 我奪走了公爵的初夜
programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.title: 競選伙伴
programme.desc: 世勳是一名成績優異的模範學生，但有一天在公車上發生的不幸事件為他得到了「erector」這個羞辱性的稱號。 合唱團指揮兼學生會主席元大邀請他參加即將舉行的學生會選舉，擔任自己的競選搭檔。為了重塑形象，世勳同意了，但他發現他是元大的第十二競選伙伴。自尊心受到傷害後，世勳決定加入相賢，一個被稱為當地交際花的行走奢侈男子.

programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 競選伙伴
programme.desc: 世勳是一名成績優異的模範學生，但有一天在公車上發生的不幸事件為他得到了「erector」這個羞辱性的稱號。 合唱團指揮兼學生會主席元大邀請他參加即將舉行的學生會選舉，擔任自己的競選搭檔。為了重塑形象，世勳同意了，但他發現他是元大的第十二競選伙伴。自尊心受到傷害後，世勳決定加入相賢，一個被稱為當地交際花的行走奢侈男子.

programme.title: 我奪走了公爵的初夜
programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.(n)

programme.title: 模範的士 2
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」替一群無法受到法律保護而滿腹冤屈的被害者們找回公理，以智慧懲罰罪犯的故事。​.(n)

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.(n)

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.(n)

programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.(n)

programme.title: 我的女友比我帥
programme.desc: 金智恩因為外婆的家族史，一天醒來發現自己變成了男人 。震驚之下，她與男友朴允在見面，並向他解釋了自己的特殊情況。在朴允在的指導下，金智恩開始學習以男人的身份生活，並延續他們的愛情故事.(n)

programme.title: 我奪走了公爵的初夜
programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.(n)

programme.title: 模範的士 2
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」替一群無法受到法律保護而滿腹冤屈的被害者們找回公理，以智慧懲罰罪犯的故事。​.(n)

programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.(n)

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.(n)

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….(n)

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.(n)

programme.title: 新生
programme.desc: 何珊被邀請到一座封閉的小島參加費可的追思會，她在那裡遇到四個互不相識的陌生人，他們被困在地下室里要求說出與費可相識的過程，然而他們發現每個人認識的費可都不一樣.

programme.title: 煥羽
programme.desc: 改編自薔嶼的同名小說，講述了轉校生喬青羽在叛逆「校草」明盛的幫助下，逐漸揭開姐姐六年前被全村人「謀殺」的真相，兩人互相救贖、共同成長的故事.

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 餘生，請多指教
programme.desc: 《餘生，請多指教》改編自柏林石匠同名小說，講述了音樂系大三學生林之校因父親生病住院，與父親的主刀醫生顧魏邂逅並相愛的故事.

programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.(c)

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(c)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(c)

programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.(n)

programme.title: 餘生，請多指教
programme.desc: 《餘生，請多指教》改編自柏林石匠同名小說，講述了音樂系大三學生林之校因父親生病住院，與父親的主刀醫生顧魏邂逅並相愛的故事.(n)

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(n)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.(n)

programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.(n)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 打歌 2025
programme.sub-title: 周震南快嘴加熱舞A爆了
programme.desc: 主打「全開麥直播+實時投票」模式，每期邀請6位歌手表演非已發行歌曲，來一場不修音、不剪輯及沒有劇本的舞台，每期的優勝歌曲可獲得持續打歌機會；邀請了周筆暢、阿雲嘎、伯遠、陳卓璇、龔琳娜、希林娜依高、何潔、吉克雋逸、孟佳、蘇醒、唐九洲、張含韻...等超強陣容，點燃今夏最炸舞台.

programme.title: 火星情報局 第7季
programme.sub-title: 德雲社首次踢館火星廠牌
programme.desc: 腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開.

programme.title: 味解鄉愁
programme.desc: 以紀實的方式表現人與家鄉美食的情感故事，通過尋訪有異鄉經歷或者當地長者、手藝人的典型故事，傳達出美食對他們的家鄉符號意義；不僅表達了對美食產生的情感記憶，還充分展現菜餚的歷史文化厚度和純正的江蘇味道.

programme.title: 快樂趣吹風
programme.sub-title: 大張偉地獄級難度猜歌力挽狂瀾
programme.desc: 由秦昊、大張偉、高瀚宇、顏人中、徐志勝、田嘉瑞組成「高能抽風團」，他們將與好友奔赴海南入住吹風小屋，以「減法生活」開啟一段旅行體驗；通過任務挑戰與即興遊戲贏取生活物資，徹底拋開偶像包袱，呈現最真實的互動與眾多「抽風」瞬間.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.sub-title: 探討戀愛中的「心動誘惑
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 顯眼包們開啟沈騰模仿大賽
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.

programme.title: 新相親大會
programme.desc: 全新模式的大型相親交友節目，男女嘉賓帶著父母家人一起登台相親，採用「雙滅雙爆燈」和「先盲後選」的全新相親模式，兩代人同場角力，展現兩代人婚戀觀的碰撞.

programme.title: 金曲撈之挑戰主打歌 第2季
programme.desc: 每集由一位原唱歌手對抗三位金曲守護人，以自己的非主打歌與主打歌同台PK，通過現場500位大眾聽審的投票決定挑戰是否成功。原唱歌手包括任賢齊、鄭少秋、吳克群、周筆暢、鄧紫棋、李克勤、趙傳、蔡健雅、許美靜、許茹芸等.

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第2季
programme.desc: 延續了上一季的基本模式，尋找一群30+都市輕熟齡男女入住 “半熟公寓”，在經歷一個月的單身公寓合租生活後，他們互相了解，走進了彼此的朋友圈、工作圈、生活圈，呈現不同的社交關係與情感發展，與陳妍希、杜海濤、喬欣、吳昕、王子文等「半熟觀察員」一起見證愛情的發生.

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳
programme.sub-title: 娘娘團集體回憶當年拍戲幕後
programme.desc: 蔡少芬、陶昕然、斕曦、張曉龍、藍盈瑩、陳思斯、楊九郎時隔13年後首次合體重聚，以全新的面貌組成「煥新團」，從承載無數記憶的《甄嬛傳》拍攝地北京大觀園出發，自北向南，由東向西，前往全國多個寶藏民族文化發源地，通過深度探訪、遊學，體驗各地民俗文化和風土人情，帶著回憶和新的憧憬環遊全國以完成“煥新之旅”.

programme.title: 音浪合夥人
programme.desc: 蘇有朋、薛之謙、王嘉爾、周筆暢、胡彥斌、歐陽娜娜等明星作為音浪召集人，他們將與300位合夥人組成3組音浪團，在24小時內緊急排練，一起完成創意十足的音樂SHOW.

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.

programme.title: 17號音樂倉庫 第二季
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 顯眼包們開啟沈騰模仿大賽
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.sub-title: 探討戀愛中的「心動誘惑
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 罪嫁
programme.desc: 尚書之女沈沅芷為戀人定罪，被迫嫁入侯府受盡樊星序報復。二人揭露顧恆遠陰謀後，又卷入叛國事件。兩人將計就計達成合作，在相處中消除誤會情愫漸生，誅殺叛徒，有情人終成眷屬.

programme.title: 橘祥如意
programme.desc: 講述了世代經營橘子產業的沈家老爺沈晏清與六弟沈晏洲同時愛上家境困頓的秀橘，為了延續沈家的香火，在大太太莊惠的安排下秀橘嫁給了沈晏清，於是四人之間開啟了一段愛恨痴纏的虐戀故事.

programme.title: 百姓的味道
programme.sub-title: 尋「味」理塘體驗藏區牧民生活
programme.desc: 美食紀錄類真人秀，由謝霆鋒擔任「美食尋味官」，與嘉賓一起探尋、領略各地風土人情、壯麗山河，品嘗民間百味；在野趣橫生的自然和充滿煙火氣的城市中，尋覓中國百姓生活，解讀百味人生.

programme.sub-title: 程瀟敦煌大秀夢回《長月燼明
programme.desc: 聚焦「齊舞」體裁，除了“元老”贊多、程瀟回歸，還邀請了楊丞琳、鄭秀妍、高瀚宇、李斯丹妮加盟主理人與原生廠牌組成6支全新的明星限定組合，共同創作不同風格的齊舞作品，通過數輪競技和淘汰，聯合征戰為尊嚴battle到底，爭奪最終的「年度最佳廠牌」榮譽.

programme.title: 子夜外賣
programme.desc: 將鏡頭聚焦外賣員這一群體，以外賣接單、送貨為線索，以溫暖動人的真情流露為內核，不僅走進他們酸甜苦辣的生活，致敬他們對社會的默默奉獻，也透過他們的眼睛，探尋和觀察「都市夜未眠」下的世情百態，照見車燈與星光裡的「煙火中國」.

programme.desc: 以一日為期限，將地點設定為日常生活的三大場景，邀請男女嘉賓在此相聚認識並展開進一步了解；打破戀綜常見的觀察室模式，主理人張純燁將與「助力團」蕭敬騰、大張偉、蒲熠星、蔡國慶、王耀慶面對面見證男女嘉賓們的感情升溫，陪伴他們經歷情感上的甜蜜與失落.

programme.desc: 一檔演員搭檔研習進階真人秀，由關錦鵬、吳鎮宇、許鞍華擔當“研習制作人”，參與研習階段任務、監制和拍攝作品，蘇可擔任“研習指導”，陳喬恩、謝娜、李維嘉、吳昕作為“研習助力團”；十多位參與的青年演員，通過共同的生活和訓練，共同開啟尋找搭檔的研習生活.

programme.title: 驚嘆俱樂部
programme.desc: 首檔東北特色喜劇推理綜藝；俱樂部由來自東北的唐鑑軍、王小利、楊樹林、文松、田娃、周雲鵬六位喜劇演員組成，以全新視角探訪城鎮，找尋兒時記憶；以輕鬆幽默的東北式調侃、機智多變的即時互動，立體展現東北地區令人驚嘆的城市風情與文化魅力，帶來歡樂體驗.

programme.title: 戶外向前沖
programme.desc: 競技類真人秀節目，聚焦於戶外露營的極致體驗，以及深入挖掘神農架地區的民俗文化精髓；嘉賓將展開活動和任務，陸續游覽著名景點和品嘗特色美食；不僅有各種精彩遊戲，更有基於神農架特色所制定的一系列新鮮的挑戰.

programme.title: 冠軍對冠軍 第二季
programme.desc: 跨項對賽體育真人秀，將帶領大家深度認知12項體育競技項目，集結二十多位體壇頂尖冠軍，一起點燃全民運動熱情，普及競技體育文化，由吳尊、范志毅組成的「超能隊」和孟鶴堂、韓天宇組成的「夢之隊」比拼較量，爭奪「冠軍戰隊」的榮耀.

programme.title: 小小騎士一起沖
programme.sub-title: 團魂燃燒 上演「速度與激情
programme.desc: 一檔親子越野成長真人秀，六組親子家庭在寧夏開啟充滿挑戰和冒險的騎行之旅；胡軍擔任小小騎士訓練營發起人，任賢齊、李晨、于文文、武藝、涂松岩、符龍飛等嘉賓將與孩子們緊密合作，共同戰勝挑戰和難題，見證孩子們在騎行路上不斷前行、不斷成長的過程.

programme.title: 一站到底
programme.desc: 《一站到底》升級進入競速時代，答題拼速度，輸贏靠積分! 選手對決人數由10人變為8人，首度開啟搶答模式，除站位獎外再增豐富答題連擊獎，連續守擂三期的選手更有機會獲得高薪工作機會.

programme.sub-title: 張顏齊仁科講述童年秘密
programme.desc: 邀請了兩位博學幽默的大叔孟非、劉震雲老友相聚，攜手“忘年交”新朋友張顏齊、李雅娟，展開代際碰撞的「交換遊學」，互相體驗對方的旅行玩法，他們將依次去往呼倫貝爾、成都、南京、昆山、大理等地，邀非見不可之人，去非來不可之地.

programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星.(n)

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 默契考驗 深度交流
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.(n)

programme.title: 17號音樂倉庫 第二季
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜.(n)

programme.title: 罪嫁
programme.desc: 尚書之女沈沅芷為戀人定罪，被迫嫁入侯府受盡樊星序報復。二人揭露顧恆遠陰謀後，又卷入叛國事件。兩人將計就計達成合作，在相處中消除誤會情愫漸生，誅殺叛徒，有情人終成眷屬.(n)

programme.title: 橘祥如意
programme.desc: 講述了世代經營橘子產業的沈家老爺沈晏清與六弟沈晏洲同時愛上家境困頓的秀橘，為了延續沈家的香火，在大太太莊惠的安排下秀橘嫁給了沈晏清，於是四人之間開啟了一段愛恨痴纏的虐戀故事.(n)

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.sub-title: 你在戀愛中感到過壓力嗎
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.(n)

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季
programme.sub-title: 新人男嘉賓人夫感滿滿
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者.(n)

programme.title: 味道 第三季
programme.desc: 以美食為介質的全新文化訪談類節目，每集邀請文化名人、名廚大師、外籍帥哥、直播網紅和民間饕客一同做客飯局，在品嚐民間美味的同時，分享人生故事.(n)

programme.title: 蛻變吧！少年
programme.desc: 在高原的藍天白雲下，6組青少年家庭在海東市完成的一場熱血又溫暖的青春蛻變，通過旅程挖掘青少年與家長之間的感人故事.(n)

programme.title: 快樂趣吹風
programme.sub-title: 大張偉徐志勝嚇得不敢出安全區
programme.desc: 由秦昊、大張偉、高瀚宇、顏人中、徐志勝、田嘉瑞組成「高能抽風團」，他們將與好友奔赴海南入住吹風小屋，以「減法生活」開啟一段旅行體驗；通過任務挑戰與即興遊戲贏取生活物資，徹底拋開偶像包袱，呈現最真實的互動與眾多「抽風」瞬間.(n)

programme.title: 打歌 2025
programme.sub-title: 劉戀慵懶聲線鬆弛感拉滿
programme.desc: 主打「全開麥直播+實時投票」模式，每期邀請6位歌手表演非已發行歌曲，來一場不修音、不剪輯及沒有劇本的舞台，每期的優勝歌曲可獲得持續打歌機會；邀請了周筆暢、阿雲嘎、伯遠、陳卓璇、龔琳娜、希林娜依高、何潔、吉克雋逸、孟佳、蘇醒、唐九洲、張含韻...等超強陣容，點燃今夏最炸舞台.(n)

programme.title: 萌探探探案 第三季
programme.sub-title: 趙麗穎謝娜寧靜勁爆闢謠
programme.desc: 沉浸式IP推理真人秀，由謝娜、黃子韜、寧靜、古力娜扎、孫紅雷、孫千、徐志勝組成「萌探家族」，他們將根據一部經典IP，進行實景還原、改編等演繹原劇片段，通過劇情的疑點及遊戲環節，獲取劇情線索，尋找劇情真相.(n)

programme.title: 盒子裡的貓
programme.desc: 全明星沉浸式劇情體驗綜藝；圍繞遊戲、喜劇兩大元素，以社會熱點話題為創作基礎，打造不同遊戲主題。一個盒子空間，一群神秘玩家，他們需要在各種離奇、爆笑和反轉中，一步步揭開故事真相，走出盒子，體驗一場專屬的心靈療愈之旅.(n)

programme.title: 火星情報局 第7季
programme.desc: 腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開.(n)

programme.title: 味解鄉愁
programme.desc: 以紀實的方式表現人與家鄉美食的情感故事，通過尋訪有異鄉經歷或者當地長者、手藝人的典型故事，傳達出美食對他們的家鄉符號意義；不僅表達了對美食產生的情感記憶，還充分展現菜餚的歷史文化厚度和純正的江蘇味道.(n)

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.(n)

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.(n)

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.sub-title: 潘瑋柏打出史上最低分
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.(n)

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 原班人馬回歸開啟粵語猜詞2.0
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.(n)

programme.title: 孤島診療所 2022
programme.desc: Shikina Island is a beautiful island located on the western edge of Japan. Kensuke Goto (Dr. Coto) came from Tokyo 19 years ago to this isolated island, 6 hours by ferry from the mainland. Since then, he has been the only doctor on the island and has borne the responsibility for the lives of all its residents. Over the years, the islanders have come to trust Coto, and Coto has come to trust them. He has become an irreplaceable presence and family member to all. A few years ago, he married Ayaka Hoshino, a nurse who has supported Coto for many years, and Ayaka is now seven months pregnant. Together with Ayaka's parents, Shoichi and Masayo, fisherman Gori Hara, former head fisherman Shigeo and his friends, Mariko, who runs a bar, and Wada, who helps out at the clinic, they live a peaceful life on the island. Now in 2022, Shikina Island, like many other rural areas in Japan, is experiencing depopulation and aging. Despite this somewhere in the back of their minds the islanders.

programme.title: 迷城
programme.desc: When former cop-turned-bar owner T-man Kwok (Louis KOO) befriends a drunken woman at closing hours (TONG Liya), they soon find themselves targeted both by her former lover-a high-powered Hong Kong attorney-and the thugs (CHANG Hsiao-Chuan) he employs. Once Kwok's underachieving half-brother (Shawn YUE) and a suitcase full of tainted cash enter the picture, the chase turns deadly, with the brothers' tense family history coming to the surface as Kwok finds himself torn between the triads and his former police colleagues.

programme.title: 特務打爆機
programme.desc: No one can stop us from going to Hawaii. Mi-yeong, an ordinary lady who sells donuts, goes on her first family trip. However, their excitement doesn't last so long. Strange people are on board with them and tries to hijack the plane. In the moment of emergency, an unexpected hero appears to save the plane. Will her dreamlike vacation come true.

programme.title: 瘦身男女
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes an fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression..

programme.title: 你好，之華
programme.desc: There are fidgety encounters, like there are uncomplicated goodbyes. All Yuan Zhinan left behind on the morning of her departure from the world was a letter and an invitation to a school reunion. Attending the reunion in lieu of her late elder sister, Zhihua accidentally ran into Yin Chuan, her crush of her youth. As old memories are evoked to a present time of reshuffled relationships, as correspondences travel through different contexts and times, Zhihua slowly uncovers the intricate story among the trio.

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for.

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -MIRROR之怪盜任務
programme.desc: Movie WE 12, starring Hong Kong's big hit boy group MIRROR, presents a passionate story full of anime vibe using fun and fresh approach. As it is MIRROR's first time starring a movie in full team of 12, the idols must have interesting behind the scene stories to share. Have there been any obstacles though? And how does 'Kaito Association' in the movie reflect MIRROR's relationship in real life.

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 12怪盜
programme.desc: In the world, which is ordinary yet a little bit extraordinary, there is an underground organization called the 'The League of Kaito'. Their members silently guard the social order and peace. Within the organization, there are 12 geniuses, each with their own unique skills. Kaito Ian is good at planning, Kaito KT is a master of hypnosis, Kaito Stanley is skilled in eavesdropping, Kaito A.Lo is most adaptable, Kaito Edan is excellent in abseiling, Kaito Jer can instantly disguise himself, Kaito Tiger knows how to read lips from a distance, Kaito Alton is a world-class hacker, Kaito AK masters animal telepathy, Kaito Lokman is familiar with unlocking techniques, Kaito Frankie has the strongest sixth sense, and Kaito Jeremy has a natural super memory and can read and memorize large amounts of information at a glance. They are the star members of the League of Kaito. One day, they received instructions from Boss, to gather at headquarters to complete an important case that will a.

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....

programme.title: 金剛王：死亡救贖
programme.desc: When he was 8-years-old, Vajrasattva was among the children sold to the Temple of Hades. Forced by his captors to fight for food, he accidentally caused the death of his brother. He made a secret oath to take revenge. Many years pass and, as an adult, Vajrasattvah is the greatest assassin in the Temple. He escapes to China and joins the Southern Shaolin Temple where he receives spiritual enlightenment and vows to protect his own country against the Japanese. Meanwhile, the Temple of Hades have set up a branch in China. It hosts daily fight competitions, openly challenging Chinese fighters. Many Chinese warriors, including prisoners-of-war from various nations, are killed in the arena and photographic evidence spread across the country as propaganda to crush the Chinese spirit. The Temple of Hades begins buying children again, training them to become assassins against their fellow Chinese.To rescue the children, Vajrasattva enters the Temple and challenges their fiercest Hade.

programme.title: 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: 東京復仇者
programme.desc: Takemichi Hanagaki leads a dead-end life in a run-down apartment while working part-time at a job for a younger manager who treats him like an idiot. Then one day, he learns that a girl he used to date during his hooligan days in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, and her brother, Naoto, have been murdered by the Kanto area's most villainous hoodlums, Tokyo Manji. The very next day, Takemichi is standing on a train platform when he is suddenly pushed onto the tracks. But instead of dying, Takemichi is transported ten years into the past where he is reunited with Hinata's younger brother, Naoto. “10 years from now, Hinata and you will be killed” he tells Naoto, thus altering the future. Hinata still doesn't survive, but Naoto does, becoming a police detective. Returning to the present day, Takemichi recruits Naoto's help in returning to the past to crush Tokyo Manji and save his Hinata's life once and for all. All Takemichi needs to do to travel through time is to shake hands w.

programme.title: 片場職人 -吳君如
programme.desc: In the second part of the interview, Sandra Ng revisits some of her early iconic comedies and tells how the giddy on-screen persona was established turning her to stay on the path of a comedian. She also gives a peek into her inner world as a female creator, unveiling the true side of this highly influential comedy actress.(c)

programme.title: 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.

programme.title: 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight..

programme.title: 30日求「分」大作戰
programme.desc: “I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.

programme.title: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: 猶瑟與虎魚們
programme.desc: A fateful encounter between average college student Tsuneo and a wheelchair-bound dreamer, Josee, who spends her time reading and painting. As Tsuneo is swept up by her dreams, Josee takes another chance at facing reality.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -許鞍華李歐梵「黃金」對談
programme.desc: In this talk, filmmaker Dr Ann Hui and Professor Leo Lee discussed the major themes & cultural background related to the early years of the Republic of China by 'The Golden Era'..

programme.title: 黃金時代
programme.desc: Xiao Hong was rescued from destitution by hard-drinking fellow writer Xiao Jun, but their fraught and competitive relationship brought her more heartache than joy..

programme.title: 極速快遞
programme.desc: “I deliver everything that the post office service does not handle.” Eun-ha, who is a normal junkyard employee, secretly works as a delivery clerk that deals with unusual delivery request. One day, Eun-ha heads to Seoul to pick up a client who is involved in a gambling crime that wants to flee overseas. However, Eun-ha meets the client's young son at the pick-up point, instead of the client himself. Kyung-pil, a current police officer who is actually masterminding the whole gambling crime, chases after the missing child who has the security key to the bank account that holds 30 million dollars. After a long pursuit from Seoul to Busan, Eun-ha fights against the police to protect the child.(c)

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 我的幸福婚約
programme.desc: In a fictional Japan of Meiji Era, a time of remarkable civilization and enlightenment, people from families that have inherited special abilities [inou] have been protecting people from various disasters together with the emperor who rules the country. Miyo Saimori was from one of the prestigious families but born without the ability, and has lived her whole life being abused by her stepmother and half-sister. She is ordered to marry a ruthless soldier, Kiyoka Kudo, who leads the Alien Force at a young age, as a political ploy. True to the rumors that numerous potential fiancees had fled within three days, Kiyoka coldly told Miyo, 'You must obey me here. If I tell you to leave, leave. If I tell you to die, you die.” Miyo, who has no place to run away to, realizes during her stay at the Kudo household that Kiyoka is not the man he is reputed to be. Kiyoka is also touched by Miyo's thoughtfulness, and the two eventually establishes a special bond with each other. A light shine.

Smash-head is a CID officer. Wracked by insecurity he believes the world will be destroyed by pollution. That's why he's an environmentalist. Carmen is a child psychologist. She specializes in hypnotism, her world is full of grace and vitality. That's why she believes in love. The two meet during a police chase. When Smash-head kills a hostage he mistakes as a kidnapper, he is put under internal investigation. And his superior tries to drag him into a corrupt syndicate. With no way out, he turns to Carmen. Under hypnotism, he remembers his long forgotten past and the image he had of himself as a young and enthusiastic fighter for justice. Holding on to this memory and the love of Carmen, he takes his pistol, number 9413..

programme.title: 女人街，再見了
programme.desc: A 11-year-old illegal immigrant, Tung, stays and lives in the Ladies' Market with T-shirt seller, Fai. One day, Tung rescued Yan who is kidnapped. Two of them bumped into van driver Pui Yi and gangster Ho..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 該死的阿修羅
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. However, what if there was a chance for these people to make different choices, will the tragedy remain? Will it be a brand new outcome if they all altered their behavior at the crucial moment.

programme.title: 單身男女
programme.desc: Yen is a single girl from China working in an IT company in Hong Kong. Overwhelmed by the hustle and bustle of this sleepless city, she feels increasingly like a fish out of water. Until she meets a handsome hunk, Sean and an elite architect, Kevin. Yen is no longer alone and lonely, but will she be able to find her true love.

programme.title: 第一刑事部的烏鴉
programme.desc: Two years have passed since Michio Irima left first criminal court (commonly known as “Ichikei”). Michio is transferred to Setouchi in Okayama Prefecture, where he is assigned to an assault case involving the youngest Minister of Defense in history. His investigations lead him to look into a collision incident involving an Aegis warship, but the details of the ships voyage are a national secret. Michio is now faced with an adversary upon which the threat of “official authority” does not work. Meanwhile, Chizuru Sakama, who has tried numerous cases with Michio, is working as a lawyer in a neighboring town under a work experience program. There, she takes on a case involving a large local company which supports the whole town, but not all is as it seems...Between these seemingly disparate cases, a shocking truth arises. Are they opening a Pandora's Box that was best left alone?

programme.title: 紅毯先生
programme.desc: The Hong Kong movie star Lau Wai-chi misses out again on the Hong Kong film awards. He sits in his office, making short videos that pay tribute to the characters he has played over his forty-year career. But trying to regain popularity this way feels desperate and cheap. He needs to make a film again. He contacts Chinese director Lin Hao, as he wants to star in a film shot in the countryside, playing an ordinary farmer, something he has never done before. This film he thinks will help restore his career to glory. Yet he is so used to being a movie star and having a special treatment in his everyday life, that it is hard for him to connect with the people of the street or peasants, people who have a lower social status than him. Even with women, there seems to exist an impassable barrier. For his new role to be successful, he needs to learn from the villagers how they really live and speak. But they see through his arrogance and vanity – as does the crew. The big star is nobod.

programme.title: 片場職人 -譚耀文
programme.desc: Patrick Tam started as a singer, who had been embracing a dream in films, later successfully turned into actor after the film “Beast Cops”. Having played antagonists throughout the years, how does he feel towards the ‘Villain Label'? In this episode, Patrick shares his experience in portraying different roles, the change in mindset after becoming an actor as well about his life insights.(c)

programme.title: 末日廝殺橋
programme.desc: Due to sudden deteriorating weather conditions, visibility on the Airport Bridge is severely impaired, leaving people stranded and at risk of the bridge collapsing due to a series of chain collisions and explosions. Amidst the chaos, the canine subjects 'Echo' from the military experiment 'Project Silence,' who were being transported in secret, break free, and all human survivors become targets of relentless attacks. Various individuals find themselves stranded on the Airport Bridge for different reasons - a government official from the presidential office who was seeing off his daughter at the airport; a tow truck driver who was on his way to a multi-collision scene; an elderly who were returning from a trip abroad; sisters who missed their flights, and Dr. Yang, the researcher responsible for Project Silence - and a desperate struggle begins for them to escape to safety.

programme.title: 消失的兇手
programme.desc: A women's prison in the Northern China in 1932, Prisoner FU Yuan (JIANG Yiyan) digs a tunnel in her prison cell with a silver spoon and escapes. Inspector SONG Donglu (LAU Ching-wan) is summoned to investigate FU's escape. By tracking down the letters sent to him by FU, it sets SONG off to Hong City to unravel FU's disappearance.

programme.title: 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize.

programme.title: 最後的怒放
programme.desc: Forty years after leaving Japan for a boxing career in the U.S. that never panned out, Jin returns to restart his life with his old boxing buddies. When hotheaded young boxer Shogo asks for Jin's help to get him back into the ring after an unfair loss, the two men decide to seize their final chance at glory.

programme.title: 逆向誘拐
programme.desc: Siu-yu, a financial analyst who has been working to complete a budget analyst for an investment bank, finds that a file containing confidential information has been mysteriously deleted. Soon after, her boss, John, receives a ransom email from someone called K Kidnapper, demanding just $190,000 worth of ransom. The ransom must be paid in 3 days, otherwise they will share the information to public. Under a detective's secret investigation, everyone could be the suspect..

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(c)

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 我知女人心
programme.desc: Sun is not exactly the ideal husband, father or son, but family takes the backseat against career. As the top brass of the leading ad agency, his mind is only fixed on being promoted to the executive creative director post. But the announcement comes and Sun is beaten by a new colleague Ly, renowned as the Iron Lady in the ad industry. The boss believes Ly would bring a competitive edge for the agency - the female perspective. Sun and Ly are at loggerheads at first sight, and she gives him an assignment - takes home a box of female hygiene products, and present an ad idea the next morning. That night, Sun is brainstorming in the bathtub when he accidentally drops a lamp in the water. The electric shock knocks him out, and when he wakes up in the hospital, he realizes he has a new gift - he can really hear what women think! By listening to the inner thoughts of the opposite sex, Sun quickly wins the hearts and trust of all women..(c)

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.(c)

programme.title: 公寓裡的兩個女人
programme.desc: Yi-jung lives with her mother Su-kyung, but they do not get along well with each other. While out grocery shopping one day, they fight as usual and Su-kyung's car ends up hitting Yi-jung in the parking lot. Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.(c)

programme.title: 非同凡響
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.(c)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: To achieve immortality, fox spirit Bai Shisan disguises as a young man and travels to the human world in search of a divine pill. There he befriends the innocent scholar Wang Zijin shom he later realizes is the key to his transcendence. To keep Wang safe, Bai must bond with him on his road to the imperial examination and fends off threats from mythic creatures and evil spirits.

programme.title: 你咪理，我愛你
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: 片場職人 -伍允龍
programme.desc: From stuntman to action choreographer, Phillip Ng's presence has spanned the spectrum of cinematic martial arts. What is it about martial arts that captivates him, driving his dedication to Hong Kong film industry? In this episode, Phillip is going to talk about his self-preparation as a stuntman and dissect the aesthetics of action films.(c)

programme.title: 武俠
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi lives a seemingly normal life in a remote village. But his peaceful life is soon to be disrupted when a determined detective digs up his past.

programme.title: 孩子轉運站
programme.desc: 'Sanghyeon' is always struggling from debt, and 'Dongsu' works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: 2013我愛HK 恭囍發財
programme.desc: Hong Kong of the 1970s - a place bustling with opportunities and riches! The earnest Sung befriended the crafty Ha and the latter also helped Song found his first job: a waiter at a Chinese Teahouse. The boss of the Teahouse is a kind man, who has an array of quirky characters as his staff. The colorful characters attracted an interesting patronage, making it a happening place for the community. Fate has it that both Sung and Ha fell for the same girl: May who is from a well-to-do family. It's face off between the geek and the smooth-talker. While romance is blossoming between May and Song, May's best friend Yuen is a gutsy girl who insisted that bad boys are attractive and only have eyes for Ha. Decades past and Sung weathered many changing times: crash of stock market; era of mass-migration and more... While Sung remained steadfast, guarding the teahouse, continuing to serve his loyal patrons and providing jobs for his long-serving staff, the fast-thinking Ha now owns a bu.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -打開世外大門
programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.(c)

programme.title: 明天你是否依然愛我
programme.desc: Fei Li is a 30-year-old IT specialist who had a secret crush on Zhao Ximan, a girl from the business department. One day, their company went on a year-end trip to Finland. At the end of the trip, Ximan accidently fell off from the ski field. The next day when she woke up in the hospital, a temporary amnesia caused a lose of her short term memory for one day. As for Li, this is an unexpected chance, he made Ximan believe that they were in love. Before Ximan could recall all the memory, Li had one day to play the role of her boyfriend.

programme.title: 飛翔吧﹗埼玉2
programme.desc: A live-action film adaptation of Mineo Maya's “Fly Me to the Saitama” turned out to be a huge, unexpected box office hit of 2019. With the producers who took the demand for a sequel as real, the cast and crew got back together to complete the second chapter of the urban legend in Fly Me To The Saitama -FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE-. In addition to the biting yet affectionate dissing of Saitama and the Kanto region in the first film, the sequel contains an even more scathing dissing of the Kansai region. Alongside costars GACKT and Fumi Nikaido, Ryo Kato and Tsubasa Masuwaka reprise their roles as members of the Saitama Liberation Front. A crucial protagonist who joins their battle, Kai Kikyo, the handsome leader of the Shiga Liberation Front, is played by Anne in her first role as male character. Akira Kashoji, the ruthless governor of Osaka and kingpin of the Kansai region who stands in the way of Rei and others, is played by Ainosuke Kataoka. In addition to Norika Fujiwara and.

programme.title: 金雞
programme.desc: It is an exploration of one woman's wacky life of prostitution, spanning over 20 years in Hong Kong. Unattractive but happy-go-lucky and spunky, KUM is a true Hong Kong survivor.(c)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(c)

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 祖宗膠戰外星人
programme.desc: In the year 2022, Guard and Thunder live on Earth, managing alien prisoners who have been locked up in humans' brains. One day, a spacecraft appears in the sky over Seoul, and the police detective Moon witnesses a strange sight...Meanwhile 630 years earlier during the Goryeo Dynasty, the hapless dosa (Korean tao magician) Muruk and Ean, the so-called “The Girl Who Shoots Thunder”, each scramble to outwit each other in pursuit of the mystical Divine Blade, for which a huge reward is being offered. Two sorcerers in search of the Divine Blade's secrets, Madam Black and Mr. Blue, as well as the masked Jajang, also set out on a desperate scramble to obtain the Blade. Meanwhile, a spacecraft emerges from a deep river, emitting light...Those who pursue alien prisoners locked in human bodies in the year 2022, and the sorcerers who pursue the legendary Divine Blade in the year 1391... When the door of time opens, everything becomes entangled.

programme.title: 猛鬼3寶
programme.desc: This anthology film features a triplet of horror stories starring up-and-coming actors and popular local Youtubers. When a film crew is haunted by paranormal activities, the director decides to cast her to play a ghost; When a taxi driver takes his girlfriend to a party room to get it on, a horny ghost adds spice to the proceedings; When a wandering ghost refuses to leave a soon-to-be-gentrified mall, the tenants concoct a plan to send her off.(n)

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -《特工爺爺》特級專訪
programme.desc: 'Bodyguard, The' follows a retired bodyguard (Sammo Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. In this interview by Now Baogu Movies, Sammo Hung (the actor, director and action director for the film) will talk about his upcoming action thriller along side actor and producer Andy Lau..(n)

programme.title: 非分熟女
programme.desc: Born in a culinary family, Siu Man has always led an ideal life - Good grades, a financially viable job and a loving husband. But one thing has always plagued her: A fear of intimacy. After the end of her sexless marriage and several life crises, Siu Man reboots her life by taking over her father's restaurant. She hires Jiahao, a ‘culinary philosopher' who takes a creative approach to cooking. To help save the restaurant, Jiahao decides to mentor Siu Man, opening her up to his culinary world. In the process, Siu Man becomes attracted to his masculinity, intelligence and his mastery of culinary skills. After seeing her usually conservative friends let loose at a wedding party, Siu Man realizes that it's time to tackle her fear of intimacy head-on. With the help of a new friend, Siu Man embarks on a journey of liberation, starting with pole dancing lessons and returning to the dating scene. When she secretly spies on Jiahao's wild tryst with another woman, Siu Man finally exper.(n)

programme.title: 小心陷井
programme.desc: Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -華麗對談
programme.desc: Johnnie To's OFFICE is a stage-to-screen musical adaptation of Design for Living, the theatre play Sylvia Chang scripted and starred in. In this talk, theatre maverick Edward Lam, Director Johnnie To and actress Sylvia Chang talk about the production process in adapting a play to film, and the differences between this movie musical and the play..(n)

programme.title: 我的青春都是你
programme.desc: It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.(n)

programme.title: 傷城
programme.desc: In a city of love and prosperity, a city of lost hope and premature death, veteran detective Hei feels it all: the hurt, the helplessness, the horror. When his father-in-law, the billionaire benefactor Chau, is gruesomely murdered in his palatial mansion, he enlists the assistance of his former partner turned private detective, Bong.(n)

programme.title: 第三個人
programme.desc: He Wei and Xiao Feng are a perfect couple. One day, her younger sister, Xiao Ke, discovers the man who murdered her parents is He Wei, and she invites him back to her home..(n)

programme.title: 戀愛大都會
programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.(n)

programme.title: 惡搞野郎與美麗癲世界
programme.desc: Three members of Japanese superstar boy band SMAP propel a trio of fantastical narratives, which ultimately converge in the chaotic fourth chapter of this wildly imaginative anthology. A pianist crosses paths with a young woman running as fast as she can. Meanwhile, a musician who cannot sing encounters a girl who eats songs, while a married couple head to Okinawa in search of their son's right arm. Anarchic, energetic, wild and wonderful, this singular celebration of creativity is helmed by a quartet of equally unhinged filmmaking visionaries, resulting in an explosive cinematic carcophony.(n)

credits.director: 園子溫, 山內健司, 太田光, 兒玉裕一

programme.title: 滿江紅
programme.desc: 12th century China, during the Song Dynasty, set against a brewing rebellion by the Jin people against the Imperial Court.Two hours before a crucial diplomatic meeting between the Song Prime Minister Qin Hui and a high level Jin delegation, the Jin Ambassador is murdered. An important letter destined for the Emperor is stolen from him. As the search for the letter unfolds, alliances are formed, secrets are revealed, and no one can stop the truth that is destined to leave its mark in history.(n)

programme.title: 年少日記
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng looks back to his repressed childhood memories, as he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. He strives hard to prevent another tragedy from happening, meanwhile facing a series of family problems, his wife is divorcing him, and his father is dying.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -翻開年少日記
programme.desc: Successful film ‘Time Still Turns The Pages' not only won four awards for new director Nick Cheuk, but also surprised the team by receiving enormous response from the society. In this interview, Nick mentions his inspiration behind the story and talks with the film's leading actress Rosa Maria Velasco about unforgettable scenes especially the outstanding performance of young actor Sean Wong. Lastly, they have the hearts set on the film to encourage the audience to get better at expressing and channeling own feelings.(n)

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 祖宗膠戰外星人2
programme.desc: Ean has become trapped in the distant past while trying to prevent the escape of alien prisoners who are locked up in the bodies of humans. She eventually locates the Divine Blade, which can open a door through time, and sets off to find Thunder in order to return to the present. Meanwhile Muruk, who helps Ean escape various predicaments, is unnerved when he begins sensing the presence of a strange being in his body. Ean and Muruk are pursued by the so-called Sorcerers of Twin Peaks, Madam Black and Mr. Blue, who suspect that a monster lies within Muruk; by the warrior Nong-pa who hopes that the Divine Blade can restore his lost eyesight; and by the sinister Jajang who seeks the Blade for his own ends. Back in the present, the release of an alien substance haava by an escaped alien prisoner known as the Controller results in the death of thousands of people. Min Gaelin who witnesses this by chance comes to realize that this is only the beginning. With only 48 minutes left bef.(n)

programme.title: 攻殼機動隊
programme.desc: In the year 2029, advances in cybernetic technology allowed people to replace body parts and organs for robotic ones. Even the brain could be replaced with a cyber-brain with the ability to gain access to the internet and different networks. Major Motoko Kusanagi, a cyborg agent working for the government, and her team have been given the assignment to track down the notorious hacker known as ‘The Puppetmaster' and uncover his plans. Her mission explores the escalating synergy between humanity and technology, while questioning the very essence of sentient existence.(n)

programme.title: 奪命金
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles.(n)

programme.title: 鬼們之蝴蝶大廈
programme.desc: A young mother and her child move into Room 606 of the infamous Butterfly Mansion, a notorious haunted building in the heart of Taipei. From the moment they arrive, eerie paranormal events begin to unfold, pushing her to uncover the dark secrets lurking within its walls. Amid the chaos, the building's new janitor-a kind and seemingly helpful young man-offers his support. But behind his warm smile lies a mystery of his own. As their paths intertwine, she realizes that everyone carries their own shadows, and the deeper she digs, the closer she gets to a chilling revelation. In Butterfly Mansion, the greatest lesson she learns is this: Humans Are More Terrifying Than Ghosts.(n)

programme.title: 遺愛
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, young mother Elisa was found guilty of manslaughter; twenty years later, her orphaned girl, Daisy, was arrested for drug possession. Tragedy remains trapped in a fateful loop cursing generations to generations of youth..(n)

programme.title: 把幸福拉近一點
programme.desc: Abandoned by her mother, Xiaofei, a positive and cheerful girl, encounters a 'Wish Come True Machine' that can fulfil people's wishes, and forms a bond with a young talent named Wai who suffers from a rare disease. While Xiaofei is finding the lost lover of Wai, it is discovered that the new medicine for treating Wai's rare disease is ineffective. However, life affects life. Although Xiaofei and Wai are hit hard by fate, they decided to continue their love and hope.(n)

programme.title: 北齋：浮世繪傳奇
programme.desc: In the Edo-era, young impecunious artist Katsushika Hokusai lived in downtown Edo. He was shabby and lived from hand to mouth with little money he earned by selling his painting on the streets. But Tsutaya Juzaburo, the one of a kind publisher, discovered Hokusai's hidden talent and led him to unleash his potentials. With Juzaburo's help, Hokusai found the essence of drawing and his talent bloomed. Meanwhile, the entertainment ban came in effect by the Edo shogunate. While Hokusai became older, he built a strong relationship with Ryutei Tanehiko, the popular playwright, who was born as a samurai and was distressed in creating new plays because of the prohibition. Eventually Tanehiko got executed by the shogunate. Hokusai came out with all his repulsion against the Edo shogunate on his vivid drawings.(n)

programme.title: 不再讓你孤單
programme.desc: When they first meet, no one can see this coming. She is a young, aggressive Beijing-based real estate agent from Hong Kong carrying an affair with a married man who also happens to be her boss. He is an honest but way too rigid policeman in his midlife crisis, who remains single to take care of his kid brother. A chance encounter in a karaoke lounge leads to an unlikely friendship. While he becomes infatuated with her, finding her pronunciation of his name the most dulcet tune he has ever heard, she is wrestling with being dumped by her boss and fired from her job at the same time. She eventually runs off to Hong Kong after borrowing almost his entire savings..(n)

programme.title: 得寵先生
programme.desc: Yam Chun Kai, is a 60-year-old curmudgeon living alone. Forced into retirement, Uncle Kai reflects on his failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter. As the hopelessness prompts him to end his life, a stray dog named Roast Piggy finds Uncle Kai and leads an animal welfare volunteer, Una Tang, to rescue him-the intelligence and humanity of Roast Piggy change Uncle Kai's attitude towards stray animals. Uncle Kai becomes friends with Una and joins her animal shelter 'Warm Home' as a volunteer, helping the abandoned animals. Una hopes Uncle Kai can take this opportunity to clear the air between him and his daughter Zoie. Just as Uncle Kai's life seems to be getting back on track, several dog poisoning incidents occur in the village he lives in..(n)

programme.title: 意外
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. After finishing a flawlessly plotted case with no trace of evidence left behind, Young-il receives a new request. His new target is a prominent political figure who is always under the spotlight. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.(n)

programme.title: 闔家辣
programme.desc: The COVID-19 pandemic offered white-collar workers everywhere the chance to work from home. At first, it seemed like a luxury to be able to work outside the shackles of the office, but people quickly realized that it could also drive them insane. For Coba, work-from-home has led to a daily cage match with his family. When he inadvertently learns that his mother's homemade chili sauce is a hit with his co-workers, he convinces his family to turn the chili sauce into an online business in order to divert their attention away from conflicts. However, Coba didn't expect that the sauce would become a timely internet sensation, thanks to families eating at home more often during the pandemic.(n)

programme.title: 網戰特攻隊
programme.desc: Talented yet arrogant city desk journalist Lim Sang-jin investigates corruption within the major corporation Manjun, only to have his report debunked as a hoax, leading to his integrity being questioned. “Your article wasn't false. It was a trick that we orchestrated” Then one day, a suspicious tip is sent to Lim. The mysterious whistleblower introduces himself as a member of the online opinion manipulation team known as Team Alep, which fabricated both truth and lies for the right price...Where does the truth begin and the lie end.(n)

programme.title: 新喜劇之王
programme.desc: Dreamy dreams of becoming a movie star, she has been working hard for years but has not been able to get beyond day player gigs. Her father gives her tremendous pressure and her family tries to convince her to quit. Only her boyfriend Charlie remains supportive. On a movie set, Dreamy runs into Marco, an actor who had once enlightened her. But Marco is washed-up now and his low self-esteem has turned him into a manic depressive. He torments Dreamy relentlessly. She continues to do her job enthusiastically, but finally cannot endure the repeated knocks on her dream and decides to give it up, go back to her parents and find a steady job. But then she gets the call: she has aced the audition she had done for a famous director for a leading role in his major film. Dreamy is now caught between her dream and reality..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 超意神探
programme.desc: Due to a hypnosis murder case, a former policeman Guo WenBin with hyperthymesia gets involved with a highly intelligent murderer challenging judicial justice. The suspect openly challenges the law and claims to be a vigilante, using bizarre means to eradicate violence. There is panic among the general public, with lives at stake and much doubt floating around. With his extraordinary memory, he works hard to uncover the mystery of this police-versus-criminal game. Hypnotized at the decisive moment, he uses his subconscious to fight against the instigation of his dark side “Suspect Zero”. He uncovers the truth about the murder and the tragedy behind it, curbing the dark side of human nature and upholding judicial justice. While redeeming himself, he also brings the real culprit to justice.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -吳君如
programme.desc: In the second part of the interview, Sandra Ng revisits some of her early iconic comedies and tells how the giddy on-screen persona was established turning her to stay on the path of a comedian. She also gives a peek into her inner world as a female creator, unveiling the true side of this highly influential comedy actress.(n)

programme.title: 販賣．愛
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before..(n)

programme.title: 飛砂風中轉
programme.desc: Two reluctant triad candidates Roast Pork & Sparrow are racking their brains to outwit each other so that they can stay out of the race for the “Dragon Head” in the underworld.(n)

programme.title: 溫暖的抱抱
programme.desc: WARM HUG is a romance-comedy revolving around a boy with OCD and is not interested in both friendship and love. However, after meeting a unique doctor and a carefree girl, the three of them slowly learn and understand one another along the way..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.(n)

programme.title: 閨密盜賞團
programme.desc: In 1970s South Korea, women free divers who have harvested shellfish suffer a threat to their livelihoods after a chemical factory opens in their seaside village. Using their specialty in diving and knowledge of the waters, old friends Choon-ja and Jin-sook start to smuggle goods. However, when they find out they are being set up, they plan for the most mind-bending and dangerous job to seek revenge, which could become their biggest break-or the end of it all.(n)

programme.title: 長津湖
programme.desc: The story takes place in winter, 1950. In the freezing cold Changjin Lake region, a bloody battle between the United States and China begins. Faced with the harshest conditions of extreme cold, lack of rations and vast difference in weaponry, the Chinese troops forge ahead, fearless and determined. They successfully blow up the Shuimen Bridge, making the most critical victory in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea.(n)
