programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 抱抱俏佳人
programme.desc: One night, wedding planner - Yan met a young attorney, Fun and had a one-night stand. Later, Fung did accidentally join to Yan's wedding planning company. In a special wedding, regardless of Yan against Fung, the rigid procedures of the wedding ceremony turned into a warm, touching the carnival. Customers in more than touched, the two are deeply moved a step closer so emotional. However, the emotional harm suffered psychological Yan still cannot break the shackles of courage in the face of her girlfriends Fung's hand holding a bold recognition of this relationship. At this time, her fiance - Kelvin was again disrupted Yan's emotional world. Who is her true Love....(n)

programme.title: 點對點
programme.desc: Chung returns from Canada to a drastically transformed Hong Kong and hoping to capture the city in his childhood years, graffitis a cryptic diagram near every subway station, in the form of dot-to-dot games. Soon they are discovered by Xue, a Putonghua teacher from China determined to solve these riddles as she immerses herself in our city's culture and history..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：任達華: 出埃及記
programme.desc: Tsim Kin Yip has been an ordinary beat cop for more than two decades, failing all the promotion interviews he's tried over the years. One afternoon, Tsim is on duty in the report room. Kwan Ping Man, a suspect accused of peeping in a women's washroom, is giving a statement. Tsim heard the big secret from Kwan there's a global women's organization plotting to kill all the men in the world. Tsim finds the story ridiculous but no choice but to write down what he's told. That night, Kwan's statement has gone missing. He returns to the station to take another report, but this time Kwan has switched his story and pleads guilty. It seems he has something to hide. Tsim's suspicions are aroused and he decides to do some investigating..(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(n)

programme.title: 屍蹤
programme.desc: Entering the houses with the key entrusted to him by the clients, 'Koo Jung-tae', a real estate agent with a hobby of spying on other people's lives. He becomes intrigued by SNS influencer 'Han Sora'. She posts a photo of a vegan salad while actually eating convenience store sausage, prompting him to begin spying on her closely. ‘Koo Jung-tae', eventually sneaks into ‘Han Sora's house, discovers her lifeless body on the sofa. Soon after, he starts receiving threats from someone who knows he was there. As homicide detective 'Oh Young-joo's investigation closes in on him, ‘Koo Jung-tae' is compelled to search for the real culprit using clues from 'Han Sora's social media and the people around her.(n)

programme.title: 親愛的
programme.desc: When their son goes missing, TIAN and his ex-wife find their lives thrown into turmoil. Years later, they have been tipped to find their lost son, but he sees them as strangers..(n)

programme.title: 掃毒3: 人在天涯

programme.title: 蕩寇風雲
programme.desc: During the 16th century, Japanese pirates proliferate along the Chinese coastline. In 1557, the pirates take over Cengang in Zhejiang. After months of futile advances, Commander Yu finally defeats them under the leadership of newly promoted General Qi. The pirates, however, manage to escape. No sooner has Qi identified the key weakness of the Chinese army than he starts remapping the coastal regions to eradicate the pirates. When he finds the villagers of Yiwu loyal and courageous, he drafts them into his own army which soon becomes a formidable force against the pirates, with tactics developed specifically against them. In 1561, the pirates regroup and once again attack the coastal cities of China. With both the cities of Xinhe and Taizhou under attack, Qi's army is caught between two fires. Even though most family members of his soldiers are located in Xinhe, Qi makes the tough decision to go to Taizhou and leaves his wife in charge of the fight against the pirates in Xinhe.(n)

programme.title: 銀魂 THE FINAL
programme.desc: Counting down to the destruction of the earth, Gintoki, Takasugi, Katsura are shuttling across places with clashing thoughts. However, there is someone who has sorrowful connections with them, standing in the way...... ‘Utsuro', who has a different personality from Shoyo Yoshida, the greatly respected teacher who guided the way of Gintoki's clan. To help Gintoki's clan, Shinpachi, Kagura, Shinsengumi, residents in Kabuki district and even old rivals are taking part in the battle! The gradually self-multiplying Utsuro's power, Takasugi is betting his own life to confront. The final scenery which black-and-blue Gintoki would see is...! Will Gintoki be able to claim all the things back..(n)

programme.desc: For Sarya (17), a Kurdish refugee girl in Japan, life seems to be looking up; her grades at school are enough to pursue college, she's surrounded with good friends and her relationship with Sota is becoming special. Sarya's life becomes upside down, however, when she learns that her family's refugee status is turned down, restricting her family from work and traveling across the city. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.(n)

programme.title: 絕世好賓

In this episode, Phillip is going to talk about his self-preparation as a stuntman and dissect the aesthetics of action films.(n)

Bearing family secrets, Shan was dispatched to stop Hin. During their encounters, they fall in love with each other. Even though Hin stopped the reclamation plan out of his love for Shan, Shan got injured in an accident and vanished into the sea.(n)

Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superior request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life..(n)

programme.title: 失戀急讓

programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..(n)

programme.title: 醬園弄．懸案

Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... programme.desc: Scriptwriter See is a confirmed bachelor. Wai is his devoted butler. Next door is no-good police Ko and his complaining wife Kit. Kit is beautiful and vain. See takes Ko to a macho convention chaired by young and handsome Kar. See gets the highest prize, a beautiful slave girl. She immediately turns the See household upside down. See wants to escape. Ko learns Kit's romance with Kar. He asks See for help. But Kar defeats their every move..

programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Chinese Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conquerror..

Both girls are ballyhooed as the hottest contestants, but at the end neither can make it to the top 5! What's more, Lin is dumped by her boyfriend, and gets fired at the same time. Being afraid of going home to get along with her father. Leung gives her a hand, inviting Lin to stay with her in her roof-top bungalow. But their friendship becomes short-lived when they run into a handsome and well-built young man Wong. They start to vie for his attention and his sex. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. On the wedding night of LING and LEE, three masked killers break into their house, slay LEE and force LING to engage in S. M..

Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..

Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

programme.desc: Fatboy is a helper to Grand Uncle who is the town's high priest. They are now found in the ancestral shrine of the Mas working wonders. Accompanying the body is a woman who claims to be Ma's wife and very much pregnant. But Fatboy knows his boyhood friend Ma couldn't be a husband because he was impotent..

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻鐵雞鬥蜈蚣
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hong investigates why lots of village girls have gone missing and discovers that it's organised by the law enforcer. A big fight ensures between Wong and the bad guys..

programme.title: 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..

programme.title: 魔唇劫
programme.desc: Bookworm professor Shiang Chin-Fei. During a picnic celebration, his female students are chewed apart by the moon monster that appears when the moon turns red. At first Chin-fei is a police suspect, but as the corpses mount, the cops realize there are supernatural forces at work. An archaeologist specializing in esoteric religions, a detective buddy, his ex-wife (now involved with the cop on the case) and the cops all assist in chin-fei's attempt to clear his name and solve the case. They travel to Cambodia to visit the Holy Virgin, princess of the High Wind Tribe..

The only survivor is Todd Nguyen, who is found unconscious on the vessel. When he awakes from his coma, he suffers from total amnesia. When it's discovered that Todd is a member of a Cambodian terrorist unit, an expert criminal psychiatrist convinces him that he is in fact an undercover agent sent to infiltrate the Cambodian organization..(n)

programme.desc: Country boy Lee Tong has the knack of getting into trouble with great regularity. But this time, he has to beat it all the way to the city. And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on..(n)

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity..(n)

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.(n)

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up..(n)

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..(n)

programme.title: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..(n)

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 應召女郎1988
programme.desc: A polyphonous and surprisingly complex portrayal of the lives of Hong Kong prostitutes, told through the eyes of several women of varying class and social standing whose lives are affected-directly and indirectly-by the world's oldest profession.(n)

programme.title: 女黑俠黃鶯
programme.desc: Wong Ngung wants to help her adoptive father Yip Lei-yam to eradicate Lui Pao, an evildoer in the gang. But Lui Pao forestalls them; Yip and his daughter Mocking Bird are killed, and Wong loses her memory by a big hit. A sorceress and a girl Ah Ching save her. The two women think that Wong is a rich girl, so they treat her very well and hope for repayment. Ah Ching is in love with Ah Kat, a car-repairing worker. Her mother opposes it. Her mother also bears a great debt because of gambling.(n)

programme.title: 血玫瑰
programme.desc: Chieh-ying, the head of a Macau dancing group, has a peaceful and calm life. One day, five drunken men, who were the murderers of Chieh-ying's dad, came to watch the show and had a brawl with Chieh-ying. On her way home, Chieh-ying got caught. She was raped and tortured by them. After that, Chieh-ying felt herself sick and was contracted the venereal disease. Therefore, she decided to go to Hong Kong to seek vengeance. She met a journalist and stayed at his home. To earn a living, Chieh-ying worked as a barmaid at a bar of Chow, her sister's ex-boyfriend with the help from Susan. One evening, Chieh-ying saw one of those five men when she was on the way to work. Susan lured him away so Chieh-ying could kill him. Chieh-ying then started a trail of bloody revenge..(n)

New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them..(n)

Kam wants to bribe him under his wing for business in the future..(n)

programme.title: 黃蜂尾後針
programme.desc: When Yau argues with his wife Jessica for the uneven share of dirty money, he shoots her in coma. To find out the money, Yau hires Sister Ma to look after her..(n)

programme.title: 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling..(n)

programme.desc: The story about the well brought-up girl Jennifer Yeung Ling who is a police force and have an opportunity involved in a SWAT Mission code named Fox Hunter, to capture a hard-core, borderless criminal, Yam Tung, better know by the law-enforcers as the Firefox for his violence and cunningness. Chan Hong is Jennifer partner, is an example of a street survivor. Jennifer sneaks into Mainland China illegally with Chan Hong to hurt for Yam who has done her servere damage, both mentally and physically, a nightmare that her continuously, and the driving force behind her pursuit.(n)

programme.title: 富貴列車
programme.desc: During the early reign of Republic of China, Cheng Fong Tin conducted speculative business in the Northeast frontier. Chinese Government sent secret agent Laifu to pursue him. However, Cheng was repeatedly able to escape. Train service between Shanghai and Chengdu was launched. The first train carried many high officials and noble lords including a Japanese envoy with the national treasure. It drew the attention of Shanghai triads colluding with gangsters to plunder the treasure. The train was forced to stop at Hanshui town due to the railroad was exploded by Cheng..(n)

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace..(n)

programme.desc: Magic Cop sees the original Mr. Vampire himself, Lam Ching Ying, as a modern day police officer who favors more traditional methods to fight crime. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. programme.desc: Samantha, the president of a renowned brassiere company, breaks the tradition and hires two guys, Johnny and Wayne, as brassiere designers, and requires them to submit novel design in 3 months. Lena, is discontent with this decision deliberately make things difficult for them, those two newcomers to the brassiere industry thus act like buffoon. The time is coming. Can those two guys really work out the 'Ultimate Bra'.(n)

programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..(n)

programme.desc: As a low-ranking director in Channel 9, Liu Pat turns the station's programmes tremendously vivid. So the boss of Channel 8 orders to get back the audience by hooks or by crooks..(n)

programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.(n)

programme.desc: The story to after The Conman, where Dragon's sister Ching went to study in Canada. After King and Dragon defeated Macau Mon, they became swindling partners..(n)

programme.title: 旺角揸fit人
programme.desc: As the triad boss Lek-kuen is dying after being shot, he remembers how he became a triad member. Under the influence of Brethen Sheung-yee, Lek-kuen joined the triad society. Yet, Lek-kuen is so kind in nature that his superior and colleagues always betray him. He escapes to Japan but is still attacked by enemies, embroiling his wife Wooden Cart Noodle being killed. Afterwards, Lek-kuen becomes the worst guy among the triad members. At this moment, the story returns to the space-time when Lek-kuen is dying. In fact, he trumps up the mentioned story. The truth is that Lek-kuen does all kinds of evil but he survives from assassination. During the tussle between the Japanese triads and Hong Kong police, Lek-kuen is saved by a mysterious lady. Nevertheless, he is finally shot dead though nobody knows who the murderer is..(n)

programme.title: 醉拳III
programme.desc: After the reformation of the government, Yuen Sai Hoi was elected President but he himself proclaimed as king. Yuen believed that on his way of the Crown Ceremony, the Jade ring wearing in his wife Sham Yuk's hand would be a sign of prosperity and stability to the throne, so he sent his servant Yeung Kwun to bring Sham Yuk to the Palace. As surrounded by enemies against the King, it was a tough journey for Yeung Kwun and Sham Yuk, but Yeung was successful in getting the help from Wong Kai Ying, a Kung-fu teacher and his son Wong Fai Hung and also a senior kung-fu fighter to make the journey a safe one. It happened that Wong Fai Hung learned the theme of the “Drunken Boxing” and gradually realized that Yuen Sai Hoi would not be a good King and thus Fai Hung join in the rebellious list to overthrow the kingdom of Yuen. The rebellious campaign were soon ruined by the owner of the wine shop-Lok Hung..(n)

Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him..(n)

The Priest shepherds a group of corpses home. He has to fight off some vicious devils. The Priest's classmate has been assigned the job of accompanying the coffin of a prince back to the capital. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself..(n)

programme.title: 三人做世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud..(n)

programme.title: 怒火威龍
programme.desc: In Hong Kong a retired Godfather's daughter Lisa, hired Professor Lau to assist in the search for the Crystal. Lau together with his assistant Peter to make preparation for the Crystal hunt in the forbidden land. Unfortunately, their mission was accidentally discovered by the gang leader Steven and Eddie. Steven killed Peter and Kidnapped Lau to hunt for the Crystal Madam Wu was the head of a special police squad team, her colleague were killed by a gang. Wu vowed to find the gang leader and prosecute him..(n)

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳雷老虎
programme.desc: Andy Lau leads a star-studded cast in this chronicle of one young officer's rise to power within the Hong Kong police force in the 1950s.(n)

programme.title: 鎗王
programme.desc: The key witness of a famous trial and 6 cops are assassinated. Miu knows Rick is back. Years ago in a shooting contest, Rick and Miu knew they were borne to be the sworn enemies.(n)

programme.title: 飛虎精英之人間有情
programme.desc: SWAT team member Dee is forced to go into action beyond the call of duty when his drunken father falls foul of local triad chief Hung Kwan. Hung is determined to dispose of Dee, despite the fact that his own daughter is in love with him. Dee is forced to fight for his life, and finally realizes how much his father really loves him..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 上海假期
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..(n)

programme.title: 不死情謎
programme.desc: Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him..(n)

programme.title: Grand Blue 碧藍之海 第1季
programme.desc: For the last half of their trip, the Peek-A-Boo members arrive in Miyakojima. Everyone goes for a serious dive into the majestic sea with the exception of Iori, who couldn't obtain his license. Everything is magical with the stunning coral reef, colorful fishes and sea turtles, until the members engage in PaB-style Otori (a drinking custom of Miyakojima), which turns things into a living hell..(n)

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: 詩意中國民謠與詩歌的遠行
programme.desc: The sixth season of 'Poetic China' seamlessly weaves the tapestry of Chinese classical poetry with the adventurous spirit of travel, with music serving as the keystone. In collaboration with esteemed national artists, the series ventures across the breathtaking landscapes of our great nation-mountains and seas alike-to listen to the whispering winds and the lullabies of the ocean's depths. These experiences inspire the creation of healing songs that embody the unique charm, merging the rich legacy of Chinese musical traditions with the distinctive urban identity. The program showcases the contemporary urban healing trend through a timeless melody that resonates across the ages. With the solemn duty to 'communicate the beauty of life through poetry,' the show endeavors to cultivate 'cultural confidence among the Chinese people.' Anchored in the vibrant characteristics of Shenzhen, it forges a new television format that is youthful, avant-garde, and engaging.

With a global perspective on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, it captures cutting-edge trends in economic and trade exchanges, technological innovation, cultural trends, and more between China and the world. It showcases technological achievements, trends in economic and trade exchanges, and mutual learning in civilization exchanges. Since its inception over two years ago, “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” has aired more than a hundred episodes of specialized interviews. The program integrates prominent international figures into the Greater Bay Area, where guests draw from their personal experiences living and working in the area or provide professional perspectives o.(n)

programme.title: 大匠之峰
programme.desc: 自細已立志做廚師嘅Will，今年32歲已成為法國餐廳副主廚，所烹調菜式精緻如畫。他的成廚之路是如何鍊成的？就等Coco同大家探索一下！.

programme.title: 100 樣可能
programme.desc: 壓力大？帶你進城市裡的共享避風港，把手機丟一邊好好放空。接著跟康師傅衝到中國最北的漠河追極光，還能近距離接觸馴鹿族！接下來開逛泰國批發市場，原來夜市泰奶、小吃都從這裡出貨！最後殺進成都零食批發天堂，整個倉庫都是零食，補貨補到行李箱爆開。.

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 據統計，香港每三人就有一人，一生中會患上帶狀疱疹，亦即是生蛇，生蛇主要病徵是皮膚會起水泡，刺痛感強烈，一旦延誤治療，除了感染面積擴散，可能生上眼、生上頭，更可能有神經痛後遺症，而近年有調查指岀，生蛇有年輕化的趨勢，今集就邀請內分泌及糖尿科專科醫生，為.

programme.title: 畀你食住賺回贈嘅WeWa卡呈獻 : 餓底家家走
programme.desc: 餓底今集回歸香港老味道，結果兩人差啲「食到擘唔大個口」！前有直闖觀塘私房菜，品嚐「開國第一宴」嘅復刻版！最後師傅用一粒車喱茄收服咗餓底們嘅味蕾！後有勇闖避風塘廚房！阿正爆炒小菜，妹姐仲挑戰「撈海鮮」，一個成身油、一個成身水！百味交雜嘅香港味到底有幾勁.

programme.title: 雷頓 不可思議偵探社 ～卡特莉的解謎事件簿～
升級美食
programme.desc: 《升級美食》由李尚正，盧頌恩兩位「餓底」主持再玩美食新構想！每集找來一款廉價又不失挑戰的主題食材，請來2位本地廚師挑戰烹煮，設計出各具風格特色的異國菜！第一集，兩位廚師Bosco 和Johnson 分別要用抱子甘藍為主題，煮出新煮意！不知道味道如何？.

森動香港
programme.desc: 今集從了解香港天然泥土結構開始，介紹政府各部門，如何因應香港環境，制定城市綠化佈局、正確植樹方法，未來植樹計劃研究方案，以及城市路邊植樹新指引，從各方面達至「種植有方、因地制宜，以人為本」的優質綠化原則，令香港成為一個可持續發展的宜居城市.(c)

programme.desc: 上集《港樂‧講樂Pop Up》力臻、Michael C燃起現場氣氛，今集二人期間限定組合「米臻」再接再厲為大家獻唱合唱歌《做好戀愛的覺悟》，又與樂迷大玩遊戲。力臻亦接力唱出充滿J-pop風格新歌《2882點85 ✈》，以及富巴西風情Bossa Nova的《不打烊珈琲屋》，盡顯實力唱功。. . 主持. 阮頌陽. 嘉賓主持. 周卓盈. 歌曲：. 《做好戀愛的覺悟》. 《2882點85 ✈》. 《不打烊珈琲屋.(c)

programme.desc: 鋼琴家鄧卓謙是一名輪椅使用者，5歲開始學鋼琴，畢業於英國皇家音樂學院，2024年，他在美國的約翰•甘迺迪表演藝術中心進行了首次演出，他曾與多位世界各地著名的音樂家合作和學習。. 卓謙有先天性心臟病，1歲接受手術時出了意外，導致脊髓神經缺血性受損，失去下半身的活動能力，雙腿長期缺乏運動而肌肉萎縮，12歲時由助行架改使用輪椅至今。除了要使用輪椅有點行動不便外，卓謙不覺自己與別不同。. 能夠成為鋼琴家，媽媽功不可沒，卓謙2歲時，媽媽帶他到協康會接受訓練，一開始並不知道他會玩多久，決定讓兒子自由發展，令卓謙愛上彈鋼琴。. 除了音樂外，鄧卓謙運動亦出色，曾參加里約殘奧會的乒乓球賽事。不過，音樂與運動之間，他選擇了前者希望能更專注走音樂鋼琴方向。他仍會繼續進修鋼琴，希望在音樂範疇更進一步。. 今集主持富爸爸岑幸富會和鄧卓謙一齊傾下計.(c)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 舌尖上的中國 (第四季)

programme.title: 藝坊
programme.sub-title: Tap dance & electronic tap shoes, Stuart Pearson Wright@Flowers Gallery & in the studio: percussionist Samuel Chan
programme.desc: Percussionist Samuel Chan is currently a fellow with the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra under the Orchestra Academy Hong Kong programme. As well as performing as a soloist, he is a member of the group, The Up:Strike Project. He’ll be joining us later. Before that though, we’re looking at a highly percussive form of dance: tap dance. Originating in the United States some 300 years ago, born of Irish and West African step dance traditions, it often accompanied jazz music, as dancers improvised to jazz music. And there are tap dance aficionados in Hong Kong too, where one dance group not only focuses on the art form but is also keen to inject new ideas into it. . At Flowers Gallery Hong Kong, "Roadkill", Stuart Pearson Wright’s first solo exhibition in Asia, presents several portraits painted in the past five years. In this new series of works, Wright blends human figures and animal traits, also incorporating everyday objects, with theatrical exaggeration and humour. “These paintings,” he says, “embrace the ridiculous because sometimes laughter feels like the only way out of despair.(c)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 「YouTuber」取代醫生、律師成為新世代最嚮往的職業。有調查顯示，超過三成青少年將內容創作者視為理想職業。這種轉變不僅顛覆大眾對傳統「高尚職業」的認知，更凸顯新一代對「成功」的定義，已從社會地位轉向自我實現。 進入數碼年代，工作不再有地域甚至時間限制，新世代更著重職業的自主性，令「打工」變得不再吸引。傳統企業面臨人才挑戰，僵化的職場文化、固定工時等，都令新世代卻步。 這場由數碼世界發起的革命，如何影響新世代價值觀及企業職場文化呢? 本集會一一探討.(c)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 特拉維夫 – 搖滾以色列
programme.desc: 以色列最大城市特拉維夫，是個新舊薈萃的精彩地方。這裡既有古老海港城市雅法，也有摩登高樓大廈以及時尚夜店，是以色列藝術場景的重心，全國最頂尖的音樂人都在這城市當中或週邊居住。《音樂旅人》與來自以色列音樂世家、備受景仰的唱作人埃胡德巴奈見面，他帶我們到一個山上的公園，眺望著特拉維夫天際，演出其作品「迦南藍調」；接著我們與流行歌手卡羅琳娜見面，一頭爆炸裝加上天籟般的聲音，令人難以忘懷。卡羅琳娜帶我們到富藝術氣息、風景如畫的內夫德澤克，並在她家客廳為我們演出。我們又拜訪音樂人、監製兼混音師庫蒂曼，他告知我們如何製作其著名的YOUTUBE影片剪輯。 《音樂旅人》主持雅各艾德格一直在努力尋找以色列最出色的鷹嘴豆醬，終於在到訪神級餐廳阿布哈桑時心願得償。最後，我們在錄音室與古靈精怪的衝浪搖滾樂隊布姆帕姆見面，其後他們作《音樂旅人》響導，帶我們到了幾處他們鍾情的夜店見識。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年3月18日 星期二晚，10時30分 Tel Aviv, Israel’s biggest city, is a vibrant and striking blend of old and new. From the ancient port of Jaffa to modern skyscrapers and trendy nightclubs, Tel Aviv is the epicenter of Israel’s arts scene and most of the country’s top musicians live in and around the city. Music Voyager meets Ehud Banai, the revered singer-songwriter who comes from one of Israel’s most important musical families. Ehud invites us to a mountaintop park overlooking the Tel Aviv skyline where he performs his song “Caananite Blues”. We then meet Karolina, a hip and popular singer with an outstanding head of a hair and a voice to match. Karolina takes us around the artistic and picturesque Neve Tzedek neighborhood ending up with an intimate performance in her living room. We visit musician, producer and remixer Kutiman, who reveals the secrets of his famous YouTube mashups. Music Voyager host Jacob Edgar’s quest for the best hummus in Israel is finally rewarded at Tel Aviv’s legendary Abu Hassan restaurant, where hungry throngs assemble for a taste of their beguiling garbanzos. Finally, we join quirky Balkan surf-rock band Boom Pam in the recording studio before hitting the clubs of Tel Aviv as they take us to some of their favorite nightlife spots. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.3.18 TUE 10:30pm.(c)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 文化匯聚的土耳其伊斯坦堡
programme.desc: 伊斯坦堡海峽作為文化滙聚的十字路口，已有好幾千年歷史，孕育出一個在宗教、文化、語言以至美食皆多姿多彩，而且自成一格的大都會，就是伊斯坦堡，這集《音樂旅人》將要帶各位沉浸於這個聲色皆精的城市。創意澎湃的流行歌星尼爾．卡拉布拉希姆吉爾帶我們到她最愛的時尚服裝店，又給了我們一場原聲表演，唱出她的首本名曲，還獨家讓我們登門造訪，得以第一身感受這位土耳其超級巨星的生活形態。著名單簧管演奏家胡斯努．桑倫廸里奇邀請我們到風景如畫的少女島，欣賞其於海傍演奏夾歌。為了向伊斯坦堡的過去與未來乾杯，我們暢飲了一番土耳其名酒——「拉克酒」，在圍繞著街頭樂手的咖啡館內開懷舉杯。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年3月18日 星期二晚，11時00分 The crossroads of the Bosphorous strait has cultivated civilizations for thousands of years, giving rise to a sprawling metropolis that has nurtured a variety of religions, cultures, languages, cuisine … and has a rhythm that is all its own. This is Istanbul - The City of the World’s Desire, and we’ll be checking out its sights. .and sounds on this episode of Music Voyager. Creative pop star Nil Karaibrahimgil takes us to her favorite trendy boutique, treats us to unplugged performances of some her best-known songs and gives us an exclusive invitation to her private residence where we see firsthand how Turkish pop stars live. And famed clarinetist Hüsnü Şenlendirici invites us to picturesque Maiden’s Island for a jam session by the sea. We toast our exploration of Istanbul’s past and future with a hearty glass of raki, the famed Turkish liqueur, as we are serenaded by street musicians at a traditional Istanbul cafe. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.3.18 TUE 11:00pm.(c)

programme.title: 談天．說地圖
programme.sub-title: 100 Years of Aerial Survey in Hong Kong
programme.desc: One hundred years ago, an aircraft soared over Victoria Harbour, capturing the city from a bird’s eye view. Over the past century, aerial survey has not only been crucial to mapping Hong Kong, but also been witnesses of the city's transformations. From Victoria City to wartime ruins, from the economic takeoff to today's digital age, each aerial photo tells a story. From rudimentary single-engine aircraft to jet planes, from primitive film cameras to multifunctional digital cameras, how has aerial survey evolved in Hong Kong.(c)

programme.sub-title: 演藝盛薈: 漂泊的荷蘭人
programme.desc: 《漂泊的荷蘭人》講述的是受到詛咒、在海上漂流多年的幽靈船長和他的船員，要在尋得真愛後始獲救贖。他遇到了一位挪威船長的女兒珊塔，因着她誓死不移的愛，終於擺脫了厄運。. 華格納的《漂泊的荷蘭人》，三幕歌劇由德國杜塞爾多夫歌劇院製作，由香港歌劇院藝術總監兼著名男高音歌唱家莫華倫監製，波姆擔任複排導演，由著名男中音賴斯拉倫飾演荷蘭人，女高音烏爾飾演珊塔，並與香港管弦樂團及香港歌劇院合唱團攜手演出。如此強大陣容，歌劇迷不容錯過。. 《漂泊的荷蘭人》是一齣精彩動人的歌劇，故事講述的是受到詛咒、在海上漂流多年的幽靈船長和他的船員，要在尋得真愛後始獲救贖。他遇到了一位挪威船長的女兒珊塔，因着她誓死不移的愛，終於擺脫了厄運。《漂泊的荷蘭人》為華格納奠定他獨特的音樂戲劇路線，憑此成就他的大師地位。. 導演: 鄧振昌.(c)

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.sub-title: 香港味力：從海洋到餐桌
programme.desc: 《優遊記》一連兩集《香港味力》，帶觀眾踏上一片尋味之旅，走進本地廚師的廚房，看看他們如何堅持「取材於地」，以香港食材說香港故事。. 在香港，有一間香港高級日式料理的餐桌上，每一道菜都用上本地食材，無論是魚生壽司或者蔬果伴碟，甚至甜品，都蘊含著香港漁農業的文化與故事。主理這間餐廳的廚師梁漢笙 ZINC，以本地石蚌、芝麻斑、賴尿蝦等等漁獲，挑戰傳統日本料理的印象。他走訪港九新界魚市場，尋找新鮮海產，又走進粉嶺水耕農場，品嚐不同微菜苗和食用花為料理配料，為的是創造一頓專屬於香港的真味盛宴。. 香港的海洋，孕育的不僅是食材，更是文化與記憶。梁漢笙希望食客可以品味，每道菜背後蘊藏著香港人的驕傲與堅毅，亦能細味這座城市與海洋共生的悠久情緣，品味香港魅力，重新發現被繁華掩蓋的香港原味道。. 【旅遊達人同你傾】. 主持：陳曉樺 Hilda Chan. 嘉賓：旅遊飲食作家徐成.(c)

programme.title: 周末大電影：滾滾紅塵
programme.desc: 本片根據三毛最後一部同名作品改編。女作家沈韶華（林青霞飾）在報紙上連載她的自傳體小說《白玉蘭》，很多情節感同身受。某日，她接到了一位神秘的讀者來信。她對這個名叫章能才（秦漢飾）的男人充滿了好奇。終於，兩人見面，一見鍾情。然而，因為章是漢奸，常有外人滋事，令韶華很是不安。此時，她的閨中密友月鳳（張曼玉飾）因與男友（嚴浩飾）賭氣，來找她傾訴。韶華一邊規勸，一邊把愛人介紹給她。三人一起出遊，感情很好。然而，見到日本軍人凌辱中國人，月鳳頓覺章面目可憎。三人鬧得不歡而散。此後，時局動盪，日本投降，國共開戰，韶華的情感經歷了更加複雜的波瀾……. 演員：林青霞、秦漢、張曼玉、吳耀漢、顧美華、嚴浩.(c)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 榮升媽媽後，美麗人妻連詩雅(Shiga)依然保持著令人稱羨的靚樣與 Fit 爆身型。究竟她坐月時最常吃什麼？Shiga對囡囡的飲食極為重視，小小年紀的Camila又最愛吃什麼？為何廚師主持Mabel 都大讚Shiga為「隱世健康廚神」？心臟科醫生則講解肥胖與心血管疾病的關係。. 鴿肉富蛋白質、鐵質又易吸收，一鴿勝九雞。論乳鴿，中山石岐馳名中外，識食專員親身到當地養鴿場，了解優質乳鴿是如何養成的。大廚 Mabel創意炮製一道中西合璧的「羊肚菌菠菜乳鴿釀飯」，教大家將傳統補品食材變成美味與營養並重的精緻菜式。. 主持：鄭萃雯(Karen)、Mabel . 嘉賓：連詩雅(Shiga)、譚礎璋醫生（瑪麗醫院內科顧問醫生/心臟科專科.(c)

programme.title: 談天．說地圖
programme.sub-title: 100 Years of Aerial Survey in Hong Kong
programme.desc: One hundred years ago, an aircraft soared over Victoria Harbour, capturing the city from a bird’s eye view. Over the past century, aerial survey has not only been crucial to mapping Hong Kong, but also been witnesses of the city's transformations. From Victoria City to wartime ruins, from the economic takeoff to today's digital age, each aerial photo tells a story. From rudimentary single-engine aircraft to jet planes, from primitive film cameras to multifunctional digital cameras, how has aerial survey evolved in Hong Kong.(c)

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.desc: Tai O is a characteristic fishing village in Hong Kong. The dense stilts, crisscrossing waterways and bridges constitute the most beautiful scenery of Tai O. Diana, an original resident, worked hard in the city for half her life, and returned to her hometown after retirement. She became a tourism ambassador and introduced her beloved Tai O to tourists; Sanmiao and Xiaoyan also chose to give up the fast life in the city and rely on the resources given by nature. Work with your own hands and live a simple and unpretentious life;. The waters of Lantau Island are the home of Chinese white dolphins. In the past ten years, the number of Chinese white dolphins has decreased sharply, making us worry that in the future we will only see their beautiful figures in textbooks. What should we pay attention to when watching dolphins.(c)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 特拉維夫 – 搖滾以色列
programme.desc: 以色列最大城市特拉維夫，是個新舊薈萃的精彩地方。這裡既有古老海港城市雅法，也有摩登高樓大廈以及時尚夜店，是以色列藝術場景的重心，全國最頂尖的音樂人都在這城市當中或週邊居住。《音樂旅人》與來自以色列音樂世家、備受景仰的唱作人埃胡德巴奈見面，他帶我們到一個山上的公園，眺望著特拉維夫天際，演出其作品「迦南藍調」；接著我們與流行歌手卡羅琳娜見面，一頭爆炸裝加上天籟般的聲音，令人難以忘懷。卡羅琳娜帶我們到富藝術氣息、風景如畫的內夫德澤克，並在她家客廳為我們演出。我們又拜訪音樂人、監製兼混音師庫蒂曼，他告知我們如何製作其著名的YOUTUBE影片剪輯。 《音樂旅人》主持雅各艾德格一直在努力尋找以色列最出色的鷹嘴豆醬，終於在到訪神級餐廳阿布哈桑時心願得償。最後，我們在錄音室與古靈精怪的衝浪搖滾樂隊布姆帕姆見面，其後他們作《音樂旅人》響導，帶我們到了幾處他們鍾情的夜店見識。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年3月18日 星期二晚，10時30分 Tel Aviv, Israel’s biggest city, is a vibrant and striking blend of old and new. From the ancient port of Jaffa to modern skyscrapers and trendy nightclubs, Tel Aviv is the epicenter of Israel’s arts scene and most of the country’s top musicians live in and around the city. Music Voyager meets Ehud Banai, the revered singer-songwriter who comes from one of Israel’s most important musical families. Ehud invites us to a mountaintop park overlooking the Tel Aviv skyline where he performs his song “Caananite Blues”. We then meet Karolina, a hip and popular singer with an outstanding head of a hair and a voice to match. Karolina takes us around the artistic and picturesque Neve Tzedek neighborhood ending up with an intimate performance in her living room. We visit musician, producer and remixer Kutiman, who reveals the secrets of his famous YouTube mashups. Music Voyager host Jacob Edgar’s quest for the best hummus in Israel is finally rewarded at Tel Aviv’s legendary Abu Hassan restaurant, where hungry throngs assemble for a taste of their beguiling garbanzos. Finally, we join quirky Balkan surf-rock band Boom Pam in the recording studio before hitting the clubs of Tel Aviv as they take us to some of their favorite nightlife spots. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.3.18 TUE 10:30pm.(c)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 文化匯聚的土耳其伊斯坦堡
programme.desc: 伊斯坦堡海峽作為文化滙聚的十字路口，已有好幾千年歷史，孕育出一個在宗教、文化、語言以至美食皆多姿多彩，而且自成一格的大都會，就是伊斯坦堡，這集《音樂旅人》將要帶各位沉浸於這個聲色皆精的城市。創意澎湃的流行歌星尼爾．卡拉布拉希姆吉爾帶我們到她最愛的時尚服裝店，又給了我們一場原聲表演，唱出她的首本名曲，還獨家讓我們登門造訪，得以第一身感受這位土耳其超級巨星的生活形態。著名單簧管演奏家胡斯努．桑倫廸里奇邀請我們到風景如畫的少女島，欣賞其於海傍演奏夾歌。為了向伊斯坦堡的過去與未來乾杯，我們暢飲了一番土耳其名酒——「拉克酒」，在圍繞著街頭樂手的咖啡館內開懷舉杯。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年3月18日 星期二晚，11時00分 The crossroads of the Bosphorous strait has cultivated civilizations for thousands of years, giving rise to a sprawling metropolis that has nurtured a variety of religions, cultures, languages, cuisine … and has a rhythm that is all its own. This is Istanbul - The City of the World’s Desire, and we’ll be checking out its sights. .and sounds on this episode of Music Voyager. Creative pop star Nil Karaibrahimgil takes us to her favorite trendy boutique, treats us to unplugged performances of some her best-known songs and gives us an exclusive invitation to her private residence where we see firsthand how Turkish pop stars live. And famed clarinetist Hüsnü Şenlendirici invites us to picturesque Maiden’s Island for a jam session by the sea. We toast our exploration of Istanbul’s past and future with a hearty glass of raki, the famed Turkish liqueur, as we are serenaded by street musicians at a traditional Istanbul cafe. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.3.18 TUE 11:00pm.(c)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十六集 - 情緒急轉彎
programme.desc: BobieLand 第五十六集-情緒急轉彎. 編導:謝曉玲. 為響應國際大笑日，BobieLand 將會舉行「哈哈哈哈大聲笑比賽」，平時愛笑的Okie Bobie 也心思思打算參加，卻擔心沒有比賽經驗自己最終會輸，但得到小隊長Jamie及QQ等人鼓勵後，他決定參加比賽⋯⋯. 【故事時間】《黑寶生氣了》. 今集請來星級媽媽陳倩揚為小朋友講故事，她帶來繪本《黑寶生氣了》，故事講述原本可愛軟萌的小貓黑寶，經常因為小事而生氣，甚至大發脾氣，即使貓頭鷹老師教了許多冷靜下來的方法，都撲滅不了黑寶的怒火，身邊所有同學也怕了他，不敢跟他玩耍，黑寶孤獨的走進樹林，不小心跌入一個山洞，傷心委屈的他終於忍不住大哭起來⋯⋯. 【冷知識】. Okie Bobie 請教愛吃的甜CC有什麼食物吃了可以笑得大聲點，甜CC建議可多吃快樂食物，Wheel仔解釋原來有些食品例如雜莓、香蕉、堅果、牛奶等等，都可以提升腦內「快樂荷爾蒙」例如多巴胺和腦內啡水平，令人感到開心愉快，自然便能開懷大笑，Okie Bobie 學到了嗎.(c)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 阿減和阿勞偷走了賽思的鎖匙，但不慎將鎖匙掉落於下水道之中。由於難以取回，尋古大師建議使用強力磁鐵。尋古大師帶領賽思前往尋找磁鐵之時，途中向她講解磁鐵的運作原理。他展示了一枚雪櫃磁貼，指出其僅有一面具備磁性。此時，阿減和阿勞再次現身企圖用磁鐵吸起賽思的鎖匙，但在尋古大師所持的巨大強力磁鐵面前，二人最終敗退.(c)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師遇見正在享用棒棒糖的小賽思和小彼德，他們隨即踏上了叢林之旅。那裡的猴子正在用樹枝從蜂巢中採集蜂蜜，仿如現代的糖果！然後，尋古大師帶孩子們去拜訪糖果師喬治·埃夫拉德，他發明了一種至今仍廣受歡迎的棒棒糖。之後，他們去了一家棒棒糖工廠，看看糖果是如何製作的！不過要小心：棒棒糖的糖分很高，孩子們不宜多吃……大人也一樣，對吧，尋古大師.(c)

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 苫前蜜瓜是北海道產量第四大的密瓜品種。苫前蜜瓜在2023年註冊，現時正在大力推廣。而小農夫嚐過蜜瓜後表現得十分興奮.(c)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：有你才是團圓
programme.desc: 由於秦月的休假，航空貸合作案交到了唐漾手上，周默暗中耍手段，唐漾輸了，但她覺得自己輸得正大光明，並不丟人。蔣時延先去試探唐漾爸爸是不是一起過年.(c)

programme.title: 悅讀憲法
programme.sub-title: 生態守護：憲法中的環境責任
programme.desc: 綠水青山就是金山銀山，代表著珍貴的資源，也是國家可持續發展的重要基石。憲法如何為生態保育與資源管理提供法律保障與發展方向？節目專訪水文專家陳滿祥工程師，了解他多年來在甘肅及黃河上游地區水資源開發與利用的研究，分享其在自然資源保護與生態教育方面的貢獻，展示憲法如何保障科研與實踐並進，推動國家與香港加快形成綠色發展方式.(c)

programme.title: 香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.desc: 布袋澳位於西貢清水灣半島的角落，因三面環山，地形仿如一個布袋而得名。布袋澳仍保存簡樸的漁村風貌，沿岸的棚屋裡也住著十幾戶漁民人家。. 漁民布水與妻子於60多年前「埋街」遷回布袋澳，前舖後居經營海鮮餐廳，「靠水食水」養活一家七口。半世紀過去，家庭式經營的餐廳由父傳子、子傳孫，迎來第三代接班人，90後的布嘉榮，一家人互相補位，經營海灣小店。. 海鮮以外，布袋澳村仍保留其獨特的傳統文化，村民信奉海上保護神天后娘娘和洪聖爺，村內的洪聖古廟建於清朝康熙初年，是本港最古老的洪聖廟之一。每年農曆八月，村民們都舉行隆重的慶祝活動，已遷居的村民都會專程回來參加，附近花炮會也會前來賀誕，相聚在這「一期一會」.(c)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第一集：秦川到職遇上西山礦大案
programme.desc: 河昌市公安局大山子派出所副所長高建設於1991年遇害，但四年過後案件仍未偵破。此時，秦川剛從省城大學畢業，主動要求回到河昌市，成為西山分局刑警隊副隊長，勢要破獲此案。然而，就在秦川報到當晚，四名匪徒到西山煤礦搶劫工資款，殺害十人，秦川趕去案發現場.(c)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.sub-title: 單手划獨木舟五公里世界紀錄保持者
programme.desc: 67 歲高誌樫是一名歷奇培訓導師，亦是單手划獨木舟五公里最快世界紀錄保持者。12 歲時攀爬圍欄執拾足球時意外跌斷右手，手術後因受細菌感染需要截肢保命，曾有一段時間配戴義肢，但覺得影響活動能力，故很快就放棄。高誌樫截肢後積極參與運動，曾代表香港參加殘奧會、遠南運動會及亞殘運等短跑及跳遠賽事。此外，他亦熱衷戶外活動，攀山、游水、踏單車都有涉獵。. 他更會單手划獨木舟，但如何掌握平衡及划水動作對高誌樫來說更是一大考驗，而且當時亦沒有教授傷殘人士划艇的相關經驗教練，全靠自己努力不懈，不服輸的心態，希望能與健全人士同行而去學習。2018年，60歲的高誌樫更創出最快完成五公里單手划獨木舟的世界紀錄，亦證明即使是殘疾及上年紀，只要勇於嘗試仍然能夠有一番作為。. 今集主持富爸爸和Wimmy會一齊跟高誌樫划獨木舟.(c)

programme.title: 31看世界 – 史前系列：跨越侏羅紀
programme.desc: 六千六百萬年前的小行星撞擊可能不是導致恐龍滅絕的原因？新的研究結果顯示，部分恐龍或能在南極洲的撞擊冬季中倖存多個世代。透過電腦特效，我們會跟隨兩隻倖存的年幼普爾塔龍一探究竟.(c)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 鋼琴家鄧卓謙是一名輪椅使用者，5歲開始學鋼琴，畢業於英國皇家音樂學院，2024年，他在美國的約翰•甘迺迪表演藝術中心進行了首次演出，他曾與多位世界各地著名的音樂家合作和學習。. 卓謙有先天性心臟病，1歲接受手術時出了意外，導致脊髓神經缺血性受損，失去下半身的活動能力，雙腿長期缺乏運動而肌肉萎縮，12歲時由助行架改使用輪椅至今。除了要使用輪椅有點行動不便外，卓謙不覺自己與別不同。. 能夠成為鋼琴家，媽媽功不可沒，卓謙2歲時，媽媽帶他到協康會接受訓練，一開始並不知道他會玩多久，決定讓兒子自由發展，令卓謙愛上彈鋼琴。. 除了音樂外，鄧卓謙運動亦出色，曾參加里約殘奧會的乒乓球賽事。不過，音樂與運動之間，他選擇了前者希望能更專注走音樂鋼琴方向。他仍會繼續進修鋼琴，希望在音樂範疇更進一步。. 今集主持富爸爸岑幸富會和鄧卓謙一齊傾下計.(c)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第八集：袁歌知道男友真面目
programme.desc: 偽裝名媛的女孩帶男朋友去SPA館辦卡，谷嶠意外聽到那男人原來已婚，想起自己被小三毀掉的婚姻，拒絕做那女孩的生意，因此被主管辭退。袁歌到鄭晉男家，告訴兩人不合適，鄭晉男說了一堆情話，就在袁歌感動時，一個女生突然出現在鄭晉男家裡，袁歌意識到谷嶠是對的.(c)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 – 史前系列：跨越侏羅紀
programme.desc: 六千六百萬年前的小行星撞擊可能不是導致恐龍滅絕的原因？新的研究結果顯示，部分恐龍或能在南極洲的撞擊冬季中倖存多個世代。透過電腦特效，我們會跟隨兩隻倖存的年幼普爾塔龍一探究竟.(c)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：楊巡獲得商場管理合同
programme.desc: 梁思申打電話約楊巡見面，楊巡答應並趕到飯店。梁思申替商場方請楊巡負責商場的經營權，但商議沒有結果。楊巡擔心會再被踢開。第二天的談判依然不歡而散。梁思申前來，勸商場方給楊巡一年時間，否則商場的虧損他們無法再繼續承受。楊巡最終簽下了商場管理合同.

programme.title: 大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：銀行信貸主任想讓楊巡提前還貸
programme.desc: 雷東寶把所有的分紅都給了前妻，讓她管理。楊巡通知雷東寶出口的退稅率會下調，讓雷東寶早做打算。雷東寶和下屬商量應對退稅率下調的辦法。銀行信貸主任想讓楊巡提前還貸，楊巡推脫，並決定把錢走，沒想到他們還是晚了一步，錢已經被轉走了。楊巡生氣地質問信貸主任.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十六集 - 情緒急轉彎
programme.desc: BobieLand 第五十六集-情緒急轉彎. 編導:謝曉玲. 為響應國際大笑日，BobieLand 將會舉行「哈哈哈哈大聲笑比賽」，平時愛笑的Okie Bobie 也心思思打算參加，卻擔心沒有比賽經驗自己最終會輸，但得到小隊長Jamie及QQ等人鼓勵後，他決定參加比賽⋯⋯. 【故事時間】《黑寶生氣了》. 今集請來星級媽媽陳倩揚為小朋友講故事，她帶來繪本《黑寶生氣了》，故事講述原本可愛軟萌的小貓黑寶，經常因為小事而生氣，甚至大發脾氣，即使貓頭鷹老師教了許多冷靜下來的方法，都撲滅不了黑寶的怒火，身邊所有同學也怕了他，不敢跟他玩耍，黑寶孤獨的走進樹林，不小心跌入一個山洞，傷心委屈的他終於忍不住大哭起來⋯⋯. 【冷知識】. Okie Bobie 請教愛吃的甜CC有什麼食物吃了可以笑得大聲點，甜CC建議可多吃快樂食物，Wheel仔解釋原來有些食品例如雜莓、香蕉、堅果、牛奶等等，都可以提升腦內「快樂荷爾蒙」例如多巴胺和腦內啡水平，令人感到開心愉快，自然便能開懷大笑，Okie Bobie 學到了嗎.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 阿減和阿勞偷走了賽思的鎖匙，但不慎將鎖匙掉落於下水道之中。由於難以取回，尋古大師建議使用強力磁鐵。尋古大師帶領賽思前往尋找磁鐵之時，途中向她講解磁鐵的運作原理。他展示了一枚雪櫃磁貼，指出其僅有一面具備磁性。此時，阿減和阿勞再次現身企圖用磁鐵吸起賽思的鎖匙，但在尋古大師所持的巨大強力磁鐵面前，二人最終敗退.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師遇見正在享用棒棒糖的小賽思和小彼德，他們隨即踏上了叢林之旅。那裡的猴子正在用樹枝從蜂巢中採集蜂蜜，仿如現代的糖果！然後，尋古大師帶孩子們去拜訪糖果師喬治·埃夫拉德，他發明了一種至今仍廣受歡迎的棒棒糖。之後，他們去了一家棒棒糖工廠，看看糖果是如何製作的！不過要小心：棒棒糖的糖分很高，孩子們不宜多吃……大人也一樣，對吧，尋古大師.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 苫前蜜瓜是北海道產量第四大的密瓜品種。苫前蜜瓜在2023年註冊，現時正在大力推廣。而小農夫嚐過蜜瓜後表現得十分興奮.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：有你才是團圓
programme.desc: 由於秦月的休假，航空貸合作案交到了唐漾手上，周默暗中耍手段，唐漾輸了，但她覺得自己輸得正大光明，並不丟人。蔣時延先去試探唐漾爸爸是不是一起過年.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 衞生署- 排隊禁煙規定
programme.desc: 為進一步降低吸煙率，保障公眾健康，政府將會在2026年1月1日開始實施多項控煙加強措施。措施包括禁止在公共交通工具排隊，以及輪候進入醫院、博物館等處所時吸煙。到底怎樣算是「排隊」? 只有一人在輪候時又可否吸煙? 衛生署人員會詳細為你講解.(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 秋葵因為形狀纖長，又叫“Lady’s fingers”，它有一種獨特的味道，中間有「滑潺潺」黏液，不是人人能夠接受；不過秋葵營養豐富，鈣質媲美牛奶。今集識食專員先落田野了解秋葵的種植過程，原來並不難種，在家露台也能種植得到。回到廚房，由廚師Will 炮製秋葵美饌，並邀請烹飪了得的謝寧、中醫師關富健任嘉賓，一起邊品嚐邊分享如何在生活中實踐「藥膳」。. 主持：羅鈺文(Yuki)、Will Leung . 嘉賓：謝寧、關富健博士（註冊中醫.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二集：西山礦案偵查發現線索
programme.desc: 曹忠恕及專家組研究推斷，11號無名屍是保衛幹部張義文在臨死前打中的一名犯罪嫌疑人，並推斷其左眼有明顯特徵。秦川指出1991年金鹿儲蓄所搶劫案中的一名犯罪嫌疑人亦有類似的眼部特徵，且此案與高建設案有關，提出併案。專案組根據線索，重點排查後鎖定嫌疑人.(n)

programme.title: 抗戰勝利80周年微短劇《抗戰》
programme.desc: 故事以香港淪陷為背景，原本打算舉家逃離香港的魚片（吳澤烽飾），因與失聯的堂兄魚毛（楊天宇飾）重遇而跟隨對方加入游擊隊。眼見村民被日軍殘害，魚片逐漸萌生愛國之心。一次行動中，魚毛選擇犧牲自己來成就大義，展現出無私的英勇與奉獻精神。80年過去，在烈士碑前，那份激動仍然留在魚片的心中.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 4
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay 主廚遠赴夏威夷的夏威夷島，展開一場尋找美味之旅。他的足跡踏遍火山地型、熱帶雨林和洶湧海洋，透過狩獵、採集以至捕魚，尋覓島上隱藏的本土風味。. 旅程尾聲，Gordon更與當地名廚Makani Carzino來一場廚藝比併，到底Gordon能否用他剛學懂的夏威夷美食文化，成功征服評判的味蕾，勝出比賽？. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年12月16日 星期二 晚上10時. Gordon Ramsay travels to the Big Island of Hawaii in search of local ingredients that are ono, or delicious. Traversing volcanic slopes, tropical rainforests and the surging ocean, he hunts, forages and fishes to discover the island’s hidden, authentic flavors. . Facing off against Chef Makani Carzino, will Gordon make the best use of Hawai‘i’s ono culinary treasures and win over the locals?. Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2025.12.16 Tue, 10pm.(n)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.desc: 吃團圓飯時，易芳萍、周景妤說起唐漾和蔣時延兒時的事。讓兩人都不好意思了，兩個當事人實在聽不下去了，藉故要去買煙花逃離了「事故現場」。程回一個人獨守在壹休加班，他給盛倪娜單獨發了一個大額紅包.(n)

programme.title: 森動香港
programme.desc: 今集從了解香港天然泥土結構開始，介紹政府各部門，如何因應香港環境，制定城市綠化佈局、正確植樹方法，未來植樹計劃研究方案，以及城市路邊植樹新指引，從各方面達至「種植有方、因地制宜，以人為本」的優質綠化原則，令香港成為一個可持續發展的宜居城市.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十七集 - 情緒急轉彎
programme.desc: BobieLand 第五十七集-情緒急轉彎. 編導:謝曉玲. 為了幫助Okie Bobie 贏得大笑比賽，小隊長Jamie召集Mika、QQ、Martin一起想辦法，大家提出一些方法例如跑步練氣、看笑話書、看笑片等，Okie Bobie 因此信心大增⋯⋯. 【故事時間】《黑寶生氣了》. 今集繼續有星級媽媽陳倩揚為小朋友講故事，上集講到小貓黑寶不小心跌入山洞，傷心委屈的他終於忍不住大哭起來，洞內傳出回音，黑寶慢慢冷靜下來，反醒自己的行為，並嘗試利用曾經用來破壞的爪子幫助自己爬出山洞，最後黑寶能否成功逃出山洞？同學們又會否原諒黑寶呢？. 【故事小手工】. 只需要簡單材料如麵粉、汽球即可製成的「摙摙舒壓球」，當你心情不好或感到壓力時，摙摙這個自製的舒壓球，即時趕走不愉快的情緒.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師熱愛自製肥皂，為了改進配方，他拜訪了一些技藝精湛的工匠。他發現，肥皂除了用作日常清潔，還能用來治理皮膚和染髮等.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師透過收音機、電視、電腦和電話，向我們展示了衛星對我們日常生活的重要，亦展示了衛星在軍事偵察及天氣預報的重要性。尋古大師前往外太空，登上了一顆在軌道運行的衛星。他發現，所有圍繞地球的物體都受到引力影響，造成了嚴重的「太空擠塞」事件.(n)

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈

programme.desc: 谷嶠來姝美面試，發現杜秉文竟然是面試官之一。在杜秉文的提點下，谷嶠成功通過面試。袁歌約見某大公司的負責人，成功說服對方給姝美一個機會，但對方提出一個條件：只要姝美能在一個月內進駐甲級商場，就答應和姝美合作。谷嶠第一天上班，因為不會用試算表程式而被嘲笑.(n)

31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 4
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay 主廚遠赴夏威夷的夏威夷島，展開一場尋找美味之旅。他的足跡踏遍火山地型、熱帶雨林和洶湧海洋，透過狩獵、採集以至捕魚，尋覓島上隱藏的本土風味。. 旅程尾聲，Gordon更與當地名廚Makani Carzino來一場廚藝比併，到底Gordon能否用他剛學懂的夏威夷美食文化，成功征服評判的味蕾，勝出比賽？. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年12月16日 星期二 晚上10時. Gordon Ramsay travels to the Big Island of Hawaii in search of local ingredients that are ono, or delicious. Traversing volcanic slopes, tropical rainforests and the surging ocean, he hunts, forages and fishes to discover the island’s hidden, authentic flavors. . Facing off against Chef Makani Carzino, will Gordon make the best use of Hawai‘i’s ono culinary treasures and win over the locals?. Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2025.12.16 Tue, 10pm.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 衞生署- 排隊禁煙規定
programme.desc: 為進一步降低吸煙率，保障公眾健康，政府將會在2026年1月1日開始實施多項控煙加強措施。措施包括禁止在公共交通工具排隊，以及輪候進入醫院、博物館等處所時吸煙。到底怎樣算是「排隊」? 只有一人在輪候時又可否吸煙? 衛生署人員會詳細為你講解.(n)

大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：楊巡運營的商場在虧損
programme.desc: 楊巡到財務主管家送了她一束花，還提出帶她去買冰箱，財務主管不肯接受。商場方聽說楊巡運營的商場一直在虧損，來找梁思申希望她或者宋運輝幫忙出面讓楊巡收了自己商場股份，梁思申斬釘截鐵地拒絕了。雷東寶對員工九十度鞠躬很是受用，並咬牙同意為雷霆的門面換好車.(n)

programme.title: 大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集：楊巡求婚成功並順利拿回股份
programme.desc: 楊巡看財務主管計算出的三套配套的營業利潤，感到胸有成竹，並決定帶她去上海談判。任遐邇卻百般推脫，楊巡當即向她求婚，並承諾如果她答應會立刻公開他們的關係。楊巡來到上海，打探後察覺到楊邐對已婚的公司老闆心生好感。楊巡順利拿回公司股份，打電話感謝梁思申。第.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十八集 - 情緒急轉彎
programme.desc: BobieLand 第五十八集-情緒急轉彎. 編導:謝曉玲. Sarah姐姐發現Okie Bobie 幾天沒到 BobieLand 當值，一問之下才知道 Okie Bobie 失聲了！原來Okie Bobie 因練習大笑而失聲，還被小隊長Jamie 取笑，所以發脾氣離開。Jamie感到內疚，認為Okie Bobie 生氣是自己的錯，澔天哥哥安慰Jamie，認為 Okie Bobie只是一時衝動。Okie Bobie 真的仍在生氣嗎？. 【More More魔術see】. Magic Kevin的魔術每次都十分精彩，這次來個大反轉，由小朋友化身魔術師，猜出Magic Kevin 的心情顏色咭，小小魔術師的表現同樣令人驚嘆。另一個魔術裡，Magic Kevin從雜亂無章的啤牌裡，找出代表小朋友心裡感受的啤牌，並將雜亂的啤牌撥亂反正。. 【Yummy Time】. 正所謂：有good morning 好簡單，只要記得食早餐，寶欣姐姐教大家用冷知識介紹過的「快樂食物」happy food做兩款營養豐富嘅早餐：香蕉雜莓燕麥脆脆杯及菠菜芝士蛋奄列，既有營養又美味，各位小朋友不妨在假期的早上跟爸爸媽媽一起做這兩款早餐，自製一個屬於你們的good morning.(n)

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集會介紹仁木町的車厘茄。仁木町不僅是北海道，更是全日本車厘茄產量最高的地方。今次會探訪一位農夫，他種植了一種名為“愛子”的車厘茄，特點是鮮甜又飽滿。參觀過種植溫室，聽過農夫講解日常運作之後，小農夫便開始親手採摘。其中一位小農夫原本不太喜愛蕃茄，不知道今次的經驗，會否令他改觀呢.(n)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：怎麼甘心做朋友
programme.desc: 蔣時延假借自己表哥的情感經歷向蔣亞男請教唐漾對自己的態度，蔣亞男判斷再三，女生並不愛蔣時延的表哥，蔣時延聽完，失落離開，而程回揭穿蔣時延表哥早就結婚了。盛倪娜家中網絡出現問題，程回上門替盛倪娜修理.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第三集：犯罪嫌疑人被查出
programme.desc: 專案組就犯罪嫌疑人宋小軍、孫哲及宋小民進行抓捕行動。抓捕行動順利執行，專案組隨即展開對三人的審訊。三人回應神態自若，審訊無法得到任何進展，故轉向從宋小軍妻子白玲尋找突破點。經過秦川一輪勸說後，白玲逐漸冷靜下來，說出了自己一直以來對宋小軍的懷疑.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第一集：阿拉斯加 - 飛翔在冰緣之上
programme.desc: Melisa 是兩個孩子的母親，也是特技飛行比賽的冠軍。她擅長在半空舞動，技藝無人能及。所有遇到她的人都會為之驚歎，而她亦希望藉此激勵其他女性。 春天標誌著德納利國家公園登山季節的開始。冰封的河流開始流淌，各種活動回復正常。Melisa也開始她的第二份工作，她為阿拉斯加最著名的空中的士公司擔任司機。飛機師必須掌握山地飛行和冰川降落的藝術。在加入這個精英團隊前，Melisa要通過一系列高空考驗。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年9月18日 星期一晚上10時30分 This young mother of two is an aerobatic champion and dances in the air like no other between the mountains. She amazes everyone who crosses her path and has made it her goal to inspire other young women to follow her example. Spring is the start of climbing season in Denali National Park. Frozen rivers are freed, activities are resuming. Melissa, who lives at 100 miles an hour, begins her second job as an aerial taxi pilot for the most famous taxi company in Alaska. Pilots must master the art of mountain aviation and glacier drop-off. Before joining this group of elite pilots, Melissa will have to pass a series of high-flying tests. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.09.18 MON 10:30pm.(n)

programme.desc: 工场老板因保单条款争拗而投诉其保险经纪，保监局法规执行部高级经理Brian伙同新下属Cindy调查时发现保险经纪未尽其职，从中探讨何谓「真相」.(n)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第十集：杜秉文心疼袁歌失戀
programme.desc: 杜秉文遇到了鄭晉男和女生約會，上前教訓鄭晉男，兩人大打出手。袁歌知道後給杜秉文送了藥油，並告訴杜秉文已和鄭晉男分手。杜秉文看見袁歌失戀的狀態，心疼袁歌。谷嶠去做市場調查時，因幫忙了一個在街上找媽媽的女孩，簡接助她日後促成了姝美與大企業簽定合同.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：宋運輝提醒雷東寶
programme.desc: 宋運輝提醒雷東寶別把提高個人待遇當成了習慣，容易迷失，並提出了對他給的工作方案的問題，雷東寶卻根本聽不進意見。楊巡帶著車隊浩浩蕩蕩地去接財務主管任遐邇，宋運輝作為證婚人致辭，婚禮在熱鬧中圓滿落幕。雷東寶被評為勞模，下屬給他安排了熱鬧的戲劇表演.(n)

programme.title: 大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：宋運輝梁思申延遲婚禮
programme.desc: 政府貸款縮緊，雷東寶讓大家都想想辦法。梁思申和宋運輝積極婚禮，但因梁父梁母被事纏住，宋運輝梁思申的婚禮延期。雷東寶帶著禮盒拜訪宋運輝，宋運輝提醒他由於東南亞金融形勢波動得厲害，雷霆需要減少出口並提高產品檔次，雷東寶則認為火還燒不到自己身上不足為慮.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十九集 - 情緒急轉彎
programme.desc: BobieLand 第五十九集-情緒急轉彎. 編導:謝曉玲. Okie Bobie 已經請了一星期病假，沒回 BobieLand 當值，Sarah姐姐唯有先找花哩碌暫代管理員職務，小隊長Jamie 擔心 Okie Bobie 因為仍生自己的氣而不回來。到了晚上，花哩碌發現Okie Bobie偷偷在園內打掃，原來 Okie Bobie 因為自己發脾氣而感到尷尬，不知如何面對Jamie所以才沒有出現，花哩碌安慰他，並告訴他Jamie 也很擔心他，到底 Okie Bobie 真的會回來BobieLand嗎？. 【嘉賓來了】. 今集請來瑜伽老師林偉欣(Charlotte)，分享瑜伽這種運動方式；同時她也是一位心理輔導師，教授小朋友調節情緒的小妙招。Charlotte老師也親身示範簡單瑜伽招式，小朋友有機會體驗瑜伽運動，舒展筋骨.(n)

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 一起來發掘我們的強壯寶寶排行榜，包括將擁有地球上最強咬合力的鹹水鱷寶寶，以及能夠攜帶體重三分之一重的獵物的小鷹。在本集中，我們將深入了解這些年幼動物的獨特生理與行為特徵，探討這些特質如何令牠們躋身動物王國中的精英行列.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 迪迪、佩佩、小特和德仔前去探望尊尼。抵達後，卻發現尊尼的拖車被一群喪屍海鸚包圍了。他們該怎麼辦.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 海鸚們趁奧圖出差時忘形地開派對，奧圖卻突然而提前回來，令海鸚們措手不及.(n)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：衝動和不衝動
programme.desc: 回到場館，唐漾當着甘一鳴的面，邀請沈律師來匯商做關於女性職場性騷擾的講座，甘一鳴面露尷尬，隨後他將唐漾引到場外空地，對唐漾動手動腳，言語無理，充滿威脅，唐漾強硬反擊.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 麥麗兒（Marine）的女兒李沛凝（Cassie）在不足27週時出生，因器官發育不全被送入深切治療部，隨後引發視膜網病變。儘管視障不致命，Cassie卻罹患罕見的先天性巨結腸症，整條大小腸缺乏神經節細胞，無法正常消化，生命危在旦夕，醫生預言她活不過十個月。經歷多次求醫，Cassie成功度過十個月的關口，但在3歲前一直住院，Marine無法回答如何熬過這段艱辛的日子，只記得醫院裡揮之不去的漂白水味道，頻繁入院讓Marine心力交瘁。. 隨著Cassie漸漸長大，終於出院回家了，並入讀心光盲人院暨學校，身體狀況開始穩定。儘管只能進食流質食物，且因治療影響學習進度，Cassie依然樂觀，滿足地說「現在就很好」。幾年前，丈夫去世，Marine不再強求甚麼，只希望Cassie健康快樂地成長。Cassie熱愛音樂，Marine全力支持她學習彈琴、唱歌和作曲。雖然Marine需兼顧工作與照顧女兒，但她希望為Cassie和其他視障學童創建NGO，提供發揮音樂才能的機會.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 性暴力受害人往往面臨複雜處境。數據顯示，2019至2023年間僅約四成受害人報警，而首次審訊的定罪率大約6%。雖然警方已提供視像作供及情緒支援，但不少受害人仍因對程序陌生、擔心漫長訴訟而不敢發聲。 目前性罪行法例中「同意」的界定，社會仍存在不同的看法。政府有意在明年修訂相關條例，內容將會包括甚麼？在現行司法程序下，性侵受害人所獲的支援與保障是否足夠？法律上應如何更清晰界定「同意」？各界又怎樣協助受害人面對報案與司法過程？本集會一一探討.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第四集：白玲口供成破案關鍵
programme.desc: 專案組實施對犯罪嫌疑人宋小軍、孫哲及宋小民的抓捕行動。抓捕行動進行順利，專案組隨即展開對三人的審訊。三人回應神態自若，專案組無法得到任何進展，因此轉向從宋小軍妻子白玲尋找突破點。經過秦川一輪勸說後，白玲逐漸冷靜下來，說出了自己一直以來對宋小軍的懷疑.(n)

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了香港觀鳥會助理項目經理鍾潤德，分享有關野鴨的知識。本集以凍原豆雁、琵嘴鴨和鴛鴦作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索野鴨的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.(n)

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 一個嘉賓不足夠？那就不如打孖上。今個星期我們請來黃淑蔓(Feanna)及應智越(細貓)一起上來做嘉賓，原來他們私底下已經相識多年，老友鬼鬼。他們今次都各自帶來多首作品外，更分享對對方的感覺，向大家透露未來工作大計。想欣賞他們的新歌，就要留意今集節目！. 主持：阮頌陽、周卓盈. 歌曲：. -《雙魚座》(周卓盈). -《梗頸四》(黃淑蔓). -《未至於》(黃淑蔓). -《i 人情歌》(應智越).(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十九集 - 情緒急轉彎
programme.desc: BobieLand 第五十九集-情緒急轉彎. 編導:謝曉玲. Okie Bobie 已經請了一星期病假，沒回 BobieLand 當值，Sarah姐姐唯有先找花哩碌暫代管理員職務，小隊長Jamie 擔心 Okie Bobie 因為仍生自己的氣而不回來。到了晚上，花哩碌發現Okie Bobie偷偷在園內打掃，原來 Okie Bobie 因為自己發脾氣而感到尷尬，不知如何面對Jamie所以才沒有出現，花哩碌安慰他，並告訴他Jamie 也很擔心他，到底 Okie Bobie 真的會回來BobieLand嗎？. 【嘉賓來了】. 今集請來瑜伽老師林偉欣(Charlotte)，分享瑜伽這種運動方式；同時她也是一位心理輔導師，教授小朋友調節情緒的小妙招。Charlotte老師也親身示範簡單瑜伽招式，小朋友有機會體驗瑜伽運動，舒展筋骨.(n)

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 一起來發掘我們的強壯寶寶排行榜，包括將擁有地球上最強咬合力的鹹水鱷寶寶，以及能夠攜帶體重三分之一重的獵物的小鷹。在本集中，我們將深入了解這些年幼動物的獨特生理與行為特徵，探討這些特質如何令牠們躋身動物王國中的精英行列.(n)

programme.desc: 蔣時延告訴唐漾自己創辦壹休好吃的初衷就是因為她，唐漾頗為感動，蔣時延乘勝追擊，表達了對唐漾的喜歡，唐漾表示自己對蔣時延有着類似朋友卻又不太一樣的喜歡，並希望兩人能夠順其自然，而這個順其自然讓蔣時延犯了迷糊.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 100歲金容到了頤養天年的年紀，年近70的女兒悅嫻期望媽媽在身心安寧的家中珍惜每一天。然而母親身體機能日益退化，跌倒後行動不便少有出門。悅嫻深感即使有工人照顧，對老人身心照料遠不止於此。為延緩腦退化的共處時光，悅嫻從媽媽的回憶重新連結母女間的話題與關係。喜愛粵劇的母女二人，更首次與家人同遊南丫島重拾粵劇追星的惜日時光.(n)

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第三集連詩雅/戰神跑. 〈跑者愛分享〉－連詩雅. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與連詩雅（Shiga）從科學園奔向大埔海濱，重溫她們人生初半馬終點相擁而泣，到跑步路上的並肩前行。兩位媽媽分享懷孕心得：「適量運動分泌安多酚，胎兒都會跟住開心！」在專注腳步中甩開煩惱，見證她們以腳步編織的健康與友誼！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－跑步，都有禮儀？. 跑步也有潛規則？標準運動場上的八條跑道，各有學問：慢跑選外線、快跑靠內線、統一逆時針跑，原來都有原因！跑步時亂玩手機、突然變速或左右亂衝，不僅會妨礙別人，更容易釀成意外。超越別人要怎樣示意才夠禮貌？減速轉線又有什麼小技巧？學懂這些跑步禮儀，大家跑得安全又開心！. 〈戰神跑〉－楊志成. 「百公里戰神」楊志成以雙腳詮釋超馬跑者的鋼鐵意志！日夜兼程的訓練為他贏得「不眠戰神」之名，堅持完成每場賽道，是對自己與支持者的一份交代。楊志成將征戰極限的系統化訓練，化為不同階層跑者的追夢階梯。從挑戰自我到開班授徒，始終秉持初心，「作為香港跑手，能推動全城運動水平進步，為此感到驕傲。.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第五集：宋小軍招供所有罪行
programme.desc: 白玲的招供為審訊打開了重要的突破口。1992年路南礦發生的一起搶劫案，與白玲交待的情況相符。當戴長江讀出白玲的口供，孫哲的心理防線被擊潰，承認是自己和宋小軍、陳小秋、陳小冬一起做的案。最後，宋小軍終承認自己殺害了高建設，如實交待了自己所有的罪行經過.(n)

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.sub-title: 香港味力：從海洋到餐桌
programme.desc: 《優遊記》一連兩集《香港味力》，帶觀眾踏上一片尋味之旅，走進本地廚師的廚房，看看他們如何堅持「取材於地」，以香港食材說香港故事。. 在香港，有一間香港高級日式料理的餐桌上，每一道菜都用上本地食材，無論是魚生壽司或者蔬果伴碟，甚至甜品，都蘊含著香港漁農業的文化與故事。主理這間餐廳的廚師梁漢笙 ZINC，以本地石蚌、芝麻斑、賴尿蝦等等漁獲，挑戰傳統日本料理的印象。他走訪港九新界魚市場，尋找新鮮海產，又走進粉嶺水耕農場，品嚐不同微菜苗和食用花為料理配料，為的是創造一頓專屬於香港的真味盛宴。. 香港的海洋，孕育的不僅是食材，更是文化與記憶。梁漢笙希望食客可以品味，每道菜背後蘊藏著香港人的驕傲與堅毅，亦能細味這座城市與海洋共生的悠久情緣，品味香港魅力，重新發現被繁華掩蓋的香港原味道。. 【旅遊達人同你傾】. 主持：陳曉樺 Hilda Chan. 嘉賓：旅遊飲食作家徐成.(n)

programme.desc: 一起來發掘我們的強壯寶寶排行榜，包括將擁有地球上最強咬合力的鹹水鱷寶寶，以及能夠攜帶體重三分之一重的獵物的小鷹。在本集中，我們將深入了解這些年幼動物的獨特生理與行為特徵，探討這些特質如何令牠們躋身動物王國中的精英行列.(n)

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：施普克的芭蕾舞劇--《睡美人》
programme.sub-title: 施普克的芭蕾舞劇--《睡美人》
programme.desc: 於1890年，芭蕾舞劇《睡美人》在聖彼得堡首演，由柴可夫斯基創作的配樂，讓這套芭蕾舞劇成為不朽之作。在編舞家施普克為蘇黎世芭蕾舞團的改編版本中，他以其獨具一格的藝術風格，將這部傳世之作再次重現。施普克透過幽默詼諧的方式，探討了成長的複雜過程。當中包括與父母的世代衝突、成年人面對的種種挑戰。在他改編的版本中，角色擺脫了傳統刻板印象。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2025年12月20日 星期六 下午3時20分 . Sleeping Beauty was premiered in St. Petersburg with Tchaikovsky’s immortal music in 1890. In his version for the Ballett Zürich, Christian Spuck revives the classic in his own artistic style. With a great deal of humor, he addresses the complex process of growing up, relating themes such as generational conflicts with one’s parents, the difficulties of becoming a mature adult. Whenever possible, he frees the characters from their traditional role clichés. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2025.12.20 SAT 3:20pm.(n)

《科學 ∙創未來3》
programme.sub-title: 第四集《數學與計算機科學獎》
programme.desc: 一項又一項的科學發明，不單改變了我們的生活，更塑造了我們的未來。. 今屆「未來科學大獎」的數學與計算機科學獎，頒贈予盧志遠教授，表揚他對非易失性存儲器的開創性研究，非易失性存儲器是資訊科技的一項關鍵技術，讓電腦在斷電之後，數據不會消失。盧教授發明的存儲器有「加熱自我修復」功能、將芯片微縮至「深度納米級別」的技術，大大提升了電腦的記憶效能，亦為未來雲端儲存、人工智慧等的發展，打下堅實的基礎.(n)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 有人會從漫畫取得靈感，烹煮美味佳餚；也有人希望自己像卡通角色擁有蛋糕魔法，向他人分享快樂，實現夢想成為烘焙師。 Tiffany陳靜曦自小患上大腦麻痺症，行動不便，兒時動過兩次大手術，又遇過校園欺凌，這些經歷沒有讓她意志消沉，相反她努力突破肢體殘障的限制。. 2014年Tiffany開設烘焙店，為他人的生活加上一點甜。在家人的協助下，Tiffany的夢想走得更遠，她施展的蛋糕魔法，令媽媽Queenie和妹妹Vivian找到自己的方向，Tiffany和媽媽合作舉辦生命烘焙工作坊，由Tiffany教授配合繪本故事的造型蛋糕，媽媽負責講故事，一起分享、討論人生；大學修讀時裝管理的Vivian亦學以致用，設計網頁、營運烘焙店，努力為烘焙事業打拼。. 今集主持Angel和 Omaira del Carmen會一同來感受這個魔法.(n)

programme.title: 悅讀憲法
programme.sub-title: 生態守護：憲法中的環境責任
programme.desc: 綠水青山就是金山銀山，代表著珍貴的資源，也是國家可持續發展的重要基石。憲法如何為生態保育與資源管理提供法律保障與發展方向？節目專訪水文專家陳滿祥工程師，了解他多年來在甘肅及黃河上游地區水資源開發與利用的研究，分享其在自然資源保護與生態教育方面的貢獻，展示憲法如何保障科研與實踐並進，推動國家與香港加快形成綠色發展方式.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 性暴力受害人往往面臨複雜處境。數據顯示，2019至2023年間僅約四成受害人報警，而首次審訊的定罪率大約6%。雖然警方已提供視像作供及情緒支援，但不少受害人仍因對程序陌生、擔心漫長訴訟而不敢發聲。 目前性罪行法例中「同意」的界定，社會仍存在不同的看法。政府有意在明年修訂相關條例，內容將會包括甚麼？在現行司法程序下，性侵受害人所獲的支援與保障是否足夠？法律上應如何更清晰界定「同意」？各界又怎樣協助受害人面對報案與司法過程？本集會一一探討.(n)

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: A Plastic Free Future. According to the latest monitoring of solid waste report by the Environmental Protection Department, Hong Kong disposes of 2,369 tonnes of plastic waste in landfills daily, equivalent to the volume of 80 double-decker buses, highlighting the urgent need to reduce plastic waste. Starting April 22, 2024 the ban on single-use plastic products prohibits businesses from providing or selling items like disposable foam tableware, plastic straws, cutlery, cotton swabs, and inflatable cheering sticks. Restaurants are also barred from offering disposable plastic cups and containers for dine-in customers. . Many "green tableware" products use water-based coatings containing small amounts of plastic to resist water and oil, but these differ from biodegradable plastics. Although recyclable and suitable for pulping, proper plastic separation is essential; otherwise, the plastic may end up in the ocean as microplastics. . How can citizens recycle effectively? What obstacles do they face? Could green technology be the key to reducing plastic pollution.(c)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到（英文版）
programme.sub-title: I’m a conversation killer. Will you still love me?
programme.desc: Every person with autism is different, with varying levels of difficulty in reciprocal communication. They fall in love, but are unable to express their love in ways that are felt and understood. In some cases, they do not even realise they are autistic. . Chiu's marriage broke up due to ineffective communication. He has a son from a subsequent relationship, which is hanging in the balance because his deficiency in communication remains. Fung and his wife often clashes but, determined to stay together, they strive to overcome the challenges in their relationship. Kitty has been reticent since she was a child. She loves her husband dearly, but has not been able to express herself adequately. . Relationship and communication issues ease up, but linger. Love lifts, love hurts. Will you still love me.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 麥麗兒（Marine）的女兒李沛凝（Cassie）在不足27週時出生，因器官發育不全被送入深切治療部，隨後引發視膜網病變。儘管視障不致命，Cassie卻罹患罕見的先天性巨結腸症，整條大小腸缺乏神經節細胞，無法正常消化，生命危在旦夕，醫生預言她活不過十個月。經歷多次求醫，Cassie成功度過十個月的關口，但在3歲前一直住院，Marine無法回答如何熬過這段艱辛的日子，只記得醫院裡揮之不去的漂白水味道，頻繁入院讓Marine心力交瘁。. 隨著Cassie漸漸長大，終於出院回家了，並入讀心光盲人院暨學校，身體狀況開始穩定。儘管只能進食流質食物，且因治療影響學習進度，Cassie依然樂觀，滿足地說「現在就很好」。幾年前，丈夫去世，Marine不再強求甚麼，只希望Cassie健康快樂地成長。Cassie熱愛音樂，Marine全力支持她學習彈琴、唱歌和作曲。雖然Marine需兼顧工作與照顧女兒，但她希望為Cassie和其他視障學童創建NGO，提供發揮音樂才能的機會.(n)

programme.title: 領遊香港 2
programme.desc: While rich in history, India has a relatively young population. Hong Kong’s relationship with the most populous country in the world can be traced back to the mid-19th century, with members of the Indian community in our city contributing to the establishment of local institutions such as The University of Hong Kong and Ruttonjee Hospital. . India is world-famous for its spices. In this episode, Ms Satwant Khanalia, Consul General of India in Hong Kong, will take our presenter Chris to taste a well-known national dish, biryani, and see how it is prepared, learning about her home country’s food culture in the process. . India is also a land of festivals, with the various mythological figures of its traditional religious tales playing a role in them. Meanwhile, a mythical beast can also be found in Hong Kong’s Hakka walled villages during festive occasions: the qilin (Chinese unicorn). Ms Khanalia and Chris will visit Liu Man Shek Tong Ancestral Hall, which has a history of over 200 years, and learn the qilin dance as well as how to make the qilin’s head used in this performance. . What is the first thing that comes to your mind when you think about Indian cinema? It is most likely the energetic, dynamic, and highly theatrical Bollywood dance. . Indian dance guru Uday Sathala has been living in Hong Kong for more than 15 years. In addition to teaching Indian dance classes, he also holds workshops at primary and secondary schools, as well as community centres, offering people from all walks of life the opportunity to learn this performing art while promoting the culture of his home.(n)

programme.title: 領遊香港 2
programme.desc: Being one of the oldest nations on Earth, France has broad and deep influences in different aspects of culture throughout history. The residence of the French Consul General in Hong Kong is almost an art exhibition hall in itself. Consul General Christile Drulhe will guides us in exploring French contemporary arts and perfume-making in her residence. . Something not many people may know is that Hong Kong has been one of France’s major jewellery importers for decades. The consul general will also be a one-day apprentices with our presenter, Chris, at a local goldsmith workshop. . The cultural exchange between Hong Kong and France is not limited to arts. French biological scientists Benoit, has been conducting research in Hong Kong for more than 10 years and contributed to archiving the city’s natural history.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 100歲金容到了頤養天年的年紀，年近70的女兒悅嫻期望媽媽在身心安寧的家中珍惜每一天。然而母親身體機能日益退化，跌倒後行動不便少有出門。悅嫻深感即使有工人照顧，對老人身心照料遠不止於此。為延緩腦退化的共處時光，悅嫻從媽媽的回憶重新連結母女間的話題與關係。喜愛粵劇的母女二人，更首次與家人同遊南丫島重拾粵劇追星的惜日時光.(n)

programme.desc: 100歲金容到了頤養天年的年紀，年近70的女兒悅嫻期望媽媽在身心安寧的家中珍惜每一天。然而母親身體機能日益退化，跌倒後行動不便少有出門。悅嫻深感即使有工人照顧，對老人身心照料遠不止於此。為延緩腦退化的共處時光，悅嫻從媽媽的回憶重新連結母女間的話題與關係。喜愛粵劇的母女二人，更首次與家人同遊南丫島重拾粵劇追星的惜日時光.(n)
